**Republican Leader Endorses Hung Cao** Virginia’s tenth district is the crosscut of America, and Leader McCarthy is committed to supporting a candidate who best represents this diverse area. We will hold President Biden accountable for his failed policies which have driven our country into a recession. I am thankful for Leader McCarthy’s support and am eager to work with him. Voters in the tenth district are ready for real leadership. _“Hung Cao is the epitome of the American Dream.__After fleeing communism in Vietnam and immigrating to the United States, he served our nation honorably for 25 years in Navy Special Operations. I'm proud to endorse Hung Cao's candidacy because I know he will bring integrity, honor, and decisive leadership to the People's House.”_ \- Leader McCarthy

clean_body: | | | | | September 21st 2022 | WEEKLY NEWSLETTER | Issue 8 | | This Week on the Campaign Trail Things are heating up on the campaign trail as we move closer to November 8th. Have you helped us in our efforts to bring the Red Wave to Virginia’s 10th district? Your time, effort, or contribution will have a big impact on the outcome of this election. Please consider how you can help Team Cao over the next few weeks. Your continuous support is greatly appreciated! Tell us how you can help → Whistle Stop Tour We traveled across Virginia’s tenth congressional district yesterday during our Whistle Stop Tour; the reception was incredible! The solution to our present-day problems lies within the spirit of the American people. We need a government that lifts us on its shoulders, not rides on our backs. We need to let Americans be Americans. With 50 days to go until November 8th, #VA10 is fired up and ready to vote for Hung Cao for Congress. Thank you to all who came out to show your support. VA-10 Congressional Debate, October 2nd Join Team Cao at the first VA-10 Congressional Debate on Sunday, October 2nd, at the Dar Alnoor Islamic Community Center. Register and show your support on October 2nd → Republican Leader Endorses Hung Cao Virginia’s tenth district is the crosscut of America, and Leader McCarthy is committed to supporting a candidate who best represents this diverse area. We will hold President Biden accountable for his failed policies which have driven our country into a recession. I am thankful for Leader McCarthy’s support and am eager to work with him. Voters in the tenth district are ready for real leadership. “Hung Cao is the epitome of the American Dream.After fleeing communism in Vietnam and immigrating to the United States, he served our nation honorably for 25 years in Navy Special Operations. I'm proud to endorse Hung Cao's candidacy because I know he will bring integrity, honor, and decisive leadership to the People's House.” \- Leader McCarthy September 11th, 2001 This past Sunday, we remembered and reflected on the 21st Anniversary of the devastating September 11th attacks on our country. During the day, we were proud to honor our first responders at Mission BBQ. In the evening, we remembered all those who served and gave their lives on September 11, 2001, at the 9/11 First Responders Memorial in Purcellville. | In The News The David Webb Show: National Review: Fox News: | Store We will not be placing a large order of hats or shirts until closer to the election. It’s becoming all the more clear that our extreme opponent’s message isn’t resonating with Marylanders. Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. **MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

name: Tiffany Smiley
subject: My story in pictures
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Smiley for Washington, Inc
body:
I wanted to share these special moments with you. [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c210334%7c0730%7c8%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c805&wdmdk=ZPAk5apDBYTBLqnSoTk2kQ&sysid=1)
I wanted to share these special moments with you.

| |
---
| | | Friend,

My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I’m running for the U.S. Senate in Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of hard work.

---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c34768%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=lONi6R3BvIhDKG%2bXziJXIQ&sysid=1 "I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of hard work.")
---

I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping others in need.

---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c34769%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=qzYxypRsMRE8gfcMfR2sBQ&sysid=1 "I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College")
---

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.

---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c34760%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=gm%2b3n9fC2o21j2Wf2F%2bu3Q&sysid=1 "I married my high school sweetheart Scotty")
---

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever, Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty’s side.

---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c34761%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=K5M8PNXGRX8hXmMgYfr5KQ&sysid=1 "Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq")
---

When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on the spot, consenting to Scotty’s immediate discharge from the Army.
_**I refused. **_
Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c34762%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Zen6jeVHMTmLe02QpTMOlw&sysid=1 "Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran
gets the benefits and care they earned.")
---

Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.

---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c34763%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=YiL4bBaWhIR3%2f8gL0WHvUw&sysid=1 "Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind active-duty Army officer,
breaking barriers for many who followed along the way. ")
---

It’s not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way--_and won._

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.

---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c34764%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=j9puFcu89Nw2apTvSRE1rA&sysid=1 "I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for
our veterans in the U.S. Senate.")
---

In 2007, we welcomed our first child. While Scotty will never be able to ‘see’ our children’s faces, he’s always been an incredible father and hero to our boys.

---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c34775%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=5pIo26kg1iRz9SWjqguHyw&sysid=1 "In 2007, we welcomed our first child.")
---

Now, our family is taking on a new challenge. I'm running for US Senate to help families across the country achieve the American Dream and save our country from Joe Biden and Patty Murray.

I will take the same fight and optimistic spirit I’ve shown throughout my life to help Washington families secure a better life. I believe that now, more than ever, Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.

---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c34776%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=rzJtHW%2bJrkSfvJJcF9Ksmw&sysid=1 "Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and
end the partisan gridlock in Congress.")
---

My family began this journey in the halls of Walter Reed and we look forward to continuing this journey in the halls of the United States Capitol.

I would love for the next photo in this story to be us winning this race with my family by my side.

We can’t do that, however, without your help, friend. _**[So please, can you chip in just a few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we’ve achieved so far.](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c34777%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Wxy1Jv7rJbCLNNUUZyyKAA&sysid=1 "So please, can you chip in just a few bucks
to help us keep up the momentum we’ve achieved so far. ")**_

---
| | | [KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c34778%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=m2CNwBeudt%2bND1SmJqcCSQ&sysid=1 "KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT")
---
| | | [STAND UP FOR AMERICA](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c34779%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=%2f0L7B1E1qXypjMla1j14QQ&sysid=1 "STAND UP FOR AMERICA")
---

I know with your support we can win this.

Sincerely,

Tiffany Smiley

---
| |

---
* * *
---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c34770%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Nx6JN2LIUatTEd5veaufpQ&sysid=1 "All Eyes On Washington")
---
Hey, it’s Tiffany Smiley.

The Washington Senate race is now the #1 battleground race in the COUNTRY!

Needless to say, all eyes are on us. We are in the FINAL DAYS until the November election, and Patty Murray is flooding millions into our state.

We are in an uphill battle, and I can’t make it up to the top without you. Not just Washingtonians, but all Americans deserve a real leader with real solutions. Together, we can ensure that the American Dream is not lost.

_**[Rush support now to be a part of history](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c34771%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=gDzGSN3SZiSFgecadSetZA&sysid=1 "Rush support now to be a part of
history")**_.

Let’s raise money and WIN,

Tiffany Smiley

---
| | | [JOIN TEAM SMILEY](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c34772%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=k1WmBeNOy81gbJen6DypPA&sysid=1 "JOIN TEAM SMILEY")
---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c34773%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=U2nES43WRKi%2fSJxAzK89EQ&sysid=1 "Alert!")
---

Team Smiley here with a RED ALERT!

You know we don't often beg, plead, or panic, but Tiffany is facing a key deadline, and we're OUT of time.

Whether or not you choose to act will decide the outcome of the Washington U.S. Senate Election:

Tiffany is currently being outraised and outspent by her 30-year incumbent opponent. We need all hands on deck to turn things around TODAY.

There's no time to wait on the sidelines.

_**[That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c34774%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=C7o6ydHIp3slbFtboX3kfg&sysid=1 "That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help
in the next 15 minutes!")**_

This is our only chance to make history and restore a brighter future for Washington and all of America. We need Tiffany Smiley in the U.S. Senate, plain and simple.

Our team doesn't want to have to deliver bad news to Tiffany later today, so we're calling on our grassroots team, including YOU, to help increase our momentum!

Tiffany is a veterans' advocate and mother of 3! She is the new, fresh leadership we desperately need in Washington! Tiffany will be your #1 supporter in the U.S. Senate.

We're out of time. There's nowhere else to turn. Tiffany needs us at this moment. _**[Step up now!](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c34785%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=U5xyyib7mmdygLfZdbqzYg&sysid=1 "Step up now!")**_

| Friend,
Last Tuesday night, **I SHOCKED the Political Establishment**...and WON the GOP nomination for Congress in New Hampshire’s 1st District as an **America First conservative**.
My name is Karoline Leavitt.
* I worked for President Trump in his White House... where **he taught me how to punch back HARD** against the Far-Left’s lies and smears,

* I'm born and raised in the New Hampshire heartland...where I learned to **cherish the conservative values** that make our nation _strong_ ,

* And, as a 25-year-old, **I’ll be the youngest woman _ever_ elected to Congress**...ready to win over the next generation to the GOP.

The Washington Establishment is NOT happy that I won my Primary.
In fact, they spent _more than $5 million dollars_ in a smear campaign against me.
Voters saw through their cynical, dishonest Swamp tactics on Primary Day...but punching back against these attacks has **badly depleted our campaign funds**.
With less than 8 weeks until Election Day, **we MUST replenish every dollar...to ensure we have the resources we need to win this Swing seat**. That’s why I’m counting on your help.
**[Join my team by pitching in $25, $50, or even $100 to reach the next generation, WIN this Swing Seat, and send me to Congress >>](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2za2pjl668oun33ls77d50ql5imog06o9e4uetp10_rp22sh2s8i66or6c3gm0o72cjh2bs)**
As the incumbent Congressman, Chris Pappas has a _huge_ head start in this race.
He’s got the **Establishment’s unified support**...he’s stockpiled millions of dollars...and he has **deep-pocketed Far-Left donors in Washington** ready to come to his rescue.
I don’t have those types of resources. **All I’ve had–since the very beginning–is the fighting spirit of conservative America First patriots like you.**
In the GOP Primary, that was more than enough to put me over the top.
But on Election Day in a Swing District like NH-1, we’ve got to do more to grow our support...and **make _sure_ we have the resources to put up a fair fight** over the next 8 weeks.
If you’re ready to FIGHT for this nation, send in someone like me who knows how to WIN. **[Pitch in $25 or more–any amount, big or small, helps! -- to get me to Washington >>](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zj7seri7tavfrouan9ubkgp69jd7r8hjh7338a00_rp22sh2s8i66or6c3gm0o72cjh2bs)** | | | | [PITCH IN $25](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zsqd7c81v2i7cp648n29a7vv7pitshui18oktha8_rp22sh2s8i66or6c3gm0o72cjh2bs)

name: Great America Update
subject: Survey on an urgent matter
body:
A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c612934%7c6341%7c6%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c1&wdmdk=aiy9fpf0CcTB4aDbuxCKew&sysid=1)
This sponsored message from Great America Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c76610%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=0iyNdYZzxEcGCwtFp3KPjQ&sysid=1) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c76611%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=X8TQMEZpDwg5eqhgijCT6g&sysid=1)** For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale’s Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c76611%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=X8TQMEZpDwg5eqhgijCT6g&sysid=1)** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been “pursuing truth and defending liberty.” Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
---

Peter,
**
Another week closer to the election and we're trying to put out another fire.**

We just received word form our campaign treasurer that my ads are going to have to come off TV early next week unless something drastic changes over the next 48 hours. Due to the downturn in fundraising over the past year, we have just not been able to raise enough money to keep our ads on the air from now through November 8th. **As it stands now, I need to raise $700 today, tomorrow and Saturday to ensure we can pay the TV stations to run our ADS next week**.

[** HELP ME KEEP MY ADS ON TV **](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60808865:W-Evf3hGN:m:1:2237666910:67540CE63BDF42B253BEEE1C400F6B3F:r)
1. We're down by 1 point in the most recent publicly available poll

2. Republicans are having a really hard time raising campaign cash, despite the fact that 85% of Americans think we're on the wrong track as a country

3. We continue to have a difficult time keeping our ADS fully funded due to our difficulty with online donations

4. It costs $7k to air one of my ads on TV per day. Every day we're not on TV, we will lose ground to my far-left opponent

With Republicans only needing 5 seats to capture the House, victory is within reach. But the fundraising gap between DEMS and REPUBS is bewildering.

**I'm asking you to help ensure my ADS don't have to come down next week. Any gift you're able to make today.**

[** HELP ME KEEP MY ADS ON TV **](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60808865:W-Evf3hGN:m:1:2237666910:67540CE63BDF42B253BEEE1C400F6B3F:r)
**Last month, The Cook Political Report upgraded the race in Oregon's 4th District from "Solid Democrat" to "Lean Democrat." That means that all of the resources we've put into this race, both in 2021 and now this year, are having their intended effect.**

If we are forced to pull our ADS off TV for even one day, **we cede ground to the Democrats we may not get back.**

God Bless,
Alek Skarlatos

body:
I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks.
[View this message in your browser](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2znpopah2cs3dn86gfo9hdvqarhn6n7rpp679vqeo_rp22sh2s8i66or6c3gm6oj1cdh238h5e8he485he5o7csn7kuij78bielqr0sbiegqb7ctl6tr779hnmmrq8cjm62qb6t9nkjhf4onhmloj8or1elqb9p74m3hr6clhmjh6edr162omcohmc8ojcd1kedg61crlcoqneduie1p64pjgm9j71p5jcdjr4sr66pjjbcr7maq6cc9gm9j61o5lcdge1d9h66qj3dbi4no)

| | | Friend,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has. The vitriol and slander I've seen so far this year has never been paralleled.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

No donation is too small. $5 makes a difference. $5 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

I know our nation's brightest days are ahead of us, but getting there isn't going to be easy. _**[We can win in November if I can count on your support right now.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z544a8iae06n7bo7lu2vnbk6t44172jk4cupfp50_rp22sh2s8i66or6c3gm6oj1cdh2bs "Johnson1")**_

Please, Friend, our future is counting on our actions today.

Thanks for reading this email. I appreciate you and your family.

Thank you for your support,
Ron

| Friend,
Last Tuesday night, **I SHOCKED the Political Establishment**...and WON the GOP nomination for Congress in New Hampshire’s 1st District as an **America First conservative**.
My name is Karoline Leavitt.
* I worked for President Trump in his White House... where **he taught me how to punch back HARD** against the Far-Left’s lies and smears,

* I'm born and raised in the New Hampshire heartland...where I learned to **cherish the conservative values** that make our nation _strong_ ,

* And, as a 25-year-old, **I’ll be the youngest woman _ever_ elected to Congress**...ready to win over the next generation to the GOP.

The Washington Establishment is NOT happy that I won my Primary.
In fact, they spent _more than $5 million dollars_ in a smear campaign against me.
Voters saw through their cynical, dishonest Swamp tactics on Primary Day...but punching back against these attacks has **badly depleted our campaign funds**.
With less than 8 weeks until Election Day, **we MUST replenish every dollar...to ensure we have the resources we need to win this Swing seat**. That’s why I’m counting on your help.
**[Join my team by pitching in $25, $50, or even $100 to reach the next generation, WIN this Swing Seat, and send me to Congress>>](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c85440%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=aBmZm8NpzJXRfHQUsyDaBA&sysid=1)**
As the incumbent Congressman, Chris Pappas has a _huge_ head start in this race.
He’s got the **Establishment’s unified support**...he’s stockpiled millions of dollars...and he has **deep-pocketed Far-Left donors in Washington** ready to come to his rescue.
I don’t have those types of resources. **All I’ve had -since the very beginning-is the fighting spirit of conservative America First patriots like you.**
In the GOP Primary, that was more than enough to put me over the top.
But on Election Day in a Swing District like NH-1, we’ve got to do more to grow our support...and **make _sure_ we have the resources to put up a fair fight** over the next 8 weeks.
If you’re ready to FIGHT for this nation, send in someone like me who knows how to WIN. **[Pitch in $25 or more-any amount, big or small, helps! \-- to get me to Washington >>](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c85441%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=zg5P5eaVpIYc1R%2bHyOCNaw&sysid=1)** | | | | [PITCH IN $25](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c85442%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=KQ0ucOngtS1R5xfL6iRZOA&sysid=1)

subject: Survey on an urgent matter
body:
A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our presi
[View this message in your browser](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zikmgggi5selme434n6fsr7lqkq8nvic11tu8pi8_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jkir39tdkmeqjetjjkorrbdt469r31d5jekrq9onicbqr6cb3m4pr1p72chobcc72ccor9pb0spp34o3keirj2ohnmqr74t3lm9j34otgsv970sj46oob4pjiegonco70mhij1o5l65iecpj664pb6p37m8r6cd776mr3fc5lclp238h1e8he4933cdj61ob3c9gmcoh5u)
This sponsored message from ICYMI News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zie9g0njtrjbjbvcugdfcpk242cnd94r7c31eor0_rp22sh2s8i66or6c3gm6oj1cph2bs) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zsahioh833p55bkr0k7g5d7lojpt3vll0kd6iu1g_rp22sh2s8i66or6c3gm6oj1cph2bs)** For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale’s Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zni674j0up5qc57b3fnp1dauincahpa1mpm7l00g_rp22sh2s8i66or6c3gm6oj1cph2bs)** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been “pursuing truth and defending liberty.” Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

name: Ron Johnson
subject: Just your endorsement
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ron Johnson For Senate, Inc
body:
I decided to run for the U.S. Senate in 2010 because growing entitlements and out-of-control federal spending had exploded our national debt to $14 trillion.
|
---
| | | Patriot,

I decided to run for the U.S. Senate in 2010 because growing entitlements and out-of-control federal spending had exploded our national debt to $14 trillion. We were on an unsustainable path that was mortgaging our children's future.

Fortunately, Americans decided that a government controlled by liberal Democrats wasn't good for the country, and they elected Republicans to the House to halt President Obama's extreme policies. A Republican majority in the Senate followed in 2014.

As I ran for re-election in 2016, we had the prospect of electing a Republican president who could work with a Republican Congress not only to stop the expansion of liberal policies but, we hoped, to reverse some of the damage done during Mr. Obama's administration. I figured we had an opportunity to put America back on the right path, and I was more than willing to dedicate myself to that worthy effort.

By and large, Republican policies worked. Regulatory relief and a more competitive tax system helped create a healthy economy with low inflation and record low unemployment. Strengthening the military deterred our enemies, and policies designed to secure the borders dramatically reduced the flow of illegal immigration.

During the 2016 campaign, I said it would be my last campaign and final term. That was my strong preference, and my wife's--we both looked forward to a normal private life. However, neither of us anticipated the Democrats' complete takeover of government and the disastrous policies they have already inflicted on America and the world, to say nothing of those they threaten to enact in the future.

Nor did we anticipate the pandemic, the government's failed response to it, the loss of freedom that has resulted, and the tyrannical approach taken by the elites who have created and maintained a state of fear that allows them to exercise control over Americans' lives. Instead of everyone working to achieve the goal President Biden stated during his inaugural address--unifying and healing America--it feels as if our nation is being torn apart.

As I travel around Wisconsin and talk to citizens who love our country, I know I am not the only one with grave concerns. My message has always been that America is precious, and it is our solemn duty to make sure it survives and thrives for future generations.

President Reagan warned that freedom is fragile, always one generation away from extinction. As I have told crowds since my first Tea Party speeches in 2010: This is a fight for freedom. This is not someone else's fight, this is our fight, and it's a fight we absolutely must win.

I believe America is in peril. Much as I'd like to ease into a quiet retirement, I don't feel I should. Countless people have encouraged me to run, saying they rely on me to be their voice, to speak plain and obvious truths other elected leaders shirk from expressing--truths the elite in government, mainstream media, and Big Tech don't want you to hear.

In 2010 I promised I would always tell people the truth and that I would never vote with re-election in mind. When re-election isn't your primary motivation, those are easy promises to keep. Today, I am announcing I will continue to fight for freedom in the public realm by running for re-election. It is a decision I haven't made lightly. Having already experienced a growing level of vitriol and false attacks, I certainly don't expect better treatment in the future. For my campaign to succeed, I will need the support of every American who values the truth and refuses to allow lies and distortions to prevail.

Tens of millions of dollars will be spent trying to destroy and defeat me. The mainstream media and Big Tech will contribute their powerful and corrupt voices as the unofficial but reliable communication apparatus of the Democrats. We face powerful forces that desire even more power and control over our lives. Their path, paved with false hope and greater dependency, always leads to tyranny. We cannot let them win.

So I will humbly ask for your endorsement to help me SAVE AMERICA.
---

Ron Johnson

11 years ago, I was shot.
The bullet damaged the left hemisphere of my brain, where the language function sits. Ever since, Aphasia has been a part of my life. When I speak, the words are there. It’s just hard for me to get them out.
**Aphasia makes it harder for me to speak. But I have not lost my voice. **
With a lot of practice I have found new ways to communicate. Through it all, Mark has been my rock. At every step of my journey, he has been there — pushing me, supporting me, making me laugh. And now, it’s my turn to help him.

body:

https://view.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=497062c79a4c617cb64327e26c61e8cb06a47b4ad4633f2ba559e67de615afdc66d56283f9a685dfcce5ca1da80a24385ad6ae76780bf7e98b1d718b3fc22246fcb0caf856ac5ca221757c9a8274f48f

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=628f0d015b52b4238c95227df79395366f132d46070f36e435a2523771b5891aaba391cf365a70004901728da85a5476c6f34aaf3f91daa3

Peter,

As the crisis at our southern border worsens, the Left seems to be up in arms and offended about everything except the crisis itself.

I haven't heard a peep about the millions of people who are being told by Biden they can just walk freely into our country. I haven’t heard a peep about these people being used and abused by the cartels.

There’s been no outrage over immigrants drowning in the Rio Grande. No outcries about the 50 immigrants found dead in the back of a truck in Texas.

I’ve heard no outrage about any of that.

The reality is, Peter, illegal immigrants are crossing the border and being left on the streets in border towns.
https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=628f0d015b52b4238c95227df79395366f132d46070f36e435a2523771b5891aaba391cf365a70004901728da85a5476c6f34aaf3f91daa3
>>">Reject Biden’s open border policy >>>

Biden and the virtue signaling Left don’t care about the safety of migrants illegally entering our country, and they don’t care about the safety of Floridians and the communities across America being destroyed by the traffickers, smugglers, and dangerous drugs freely flowing into our country.

The regime isn’t doing anything to solve the crisis at the border because this isn’t a crisis Biden inherited, it’s a crisis Biden created.

Joe, the woke Left, and their corporate press lapdogs are strategically ignoring that the problem at our border exists.

Failed Border Czar Kamala Harris is dealing with the crisis by simply declaring the border is secure, claiming there is no crisis. Biden is asserting that there are actually fewer migrants coming in through our southern border.

The reality is, the border is more open than ever before under Biden’s watch and we’ve had more illegal crossings take place under his administration than any other time in our nation’s history.

This is not a situation where Biden tried his best and it just didn’t work. This was an intentional action Biden took to reverse policies that were effective.

The Left has been chirping about political stunts to deflect from the real issues happening at the border, but the biggest political stunt by far has been Biden coming in as president and reversing policies that worked just to virtue signal to his base.
https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=628f0d015b52b4238c95227df79395366f132d46070f36e435a2523771b5891aaba391cf365a70004901728da85a5476c6f34aaf3f91daa3
>>">Fight back >>>

Joe was willing to risk the security of our nation and the safety of our communities to gain brownie points with his extremist base.

The impact of Biden’s border crisis has left our communities ravaged by destruction and despair. The sheer volume of the cartel’s dangerous drugs being brought in at such a rapid pace, it’s nearly impossible for local communities to tackle.

Biden’s refusal to take any action is devastating American communities across the United States with fentanyl now the number one cause of death for Americans between the ages of 18-45.

Americans are being victimized by criminal aliens illegally crossing the border.

These crimes are especially hard to stomach because if Biden would’ve just done his job, the crime would have never happened.

The fact of the matter is, Peter, the false outrage from the Left has nothing to do with humanity or decency – it has to do with Democrats’ seemingly inherent need to posture themselves as morally superior.
https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=628f0d015b52b4238c95227df79395366f132d46070f36e435a2523771b5891aaba391cf365a70004901728da85a5476c6f34aaf3f91daa3
>>">Hold the Left accountable >>>

There is a simple answer to our problem: secure the border.

We need leaders with integrity who are willing to put the American people above their political standings. Biden and his pocket puppets, like my opponent, wouldn’t know the meaning of integrity if it were printed on a rubber wristband or written in 78-point font on a teleprompter.

I’m working hard to keep the Left’s extremism out of Florida, but I need your help to stop them.

My mission to Keep Florida Free will require the help of every supporter. We cannot afford to sit on the sidelines as our country slips further into chaos and destruction.

body:
| |
---
| | | Friend,

My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I'm running for the U.S. Senate in Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my family's farm and learned the value of hard work.

---
| [](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c5ad5c9191e64ba790bd775a579dcc83&_e=beB3FyUxgZCQtvzHtnLi0K9zHEw1fsEbzwr3yY_vQLSqCOOQiQ2h0-4bHp07G9FrSGRCGgpZj5yAOiYvruhQn1sTnElMEJJXgA84_Kypd1J8XFksP5W8A4cbU2RF2FMLHnEe1x2gk2BDAjfAzrBOliX3SCLpq073Qrt9LEmBMQkATyHQc7B-dPdioH8gcy8eKR7dW4VvImS14BBkdF63I0417j-aSdTNFn_z2Q-b-5xND6cUAb8j-g13QuSMYQ5MVdj3fSa1gYQexbvtvhN4Kr6NC4m4xX26dhFcvau45Igd1aeDaI2aLtvTKwx2evhUFfe7DvKFKAR2YV9ggoJxfvpOnjthS95SnC0BwitH1fXR7TDu9CcpCJYQHwAOaR0byVYBzUiui6S3zCaWHSqLTdE5zOFINkNhBjCMhAcet5EchOpgyPEcSpZVUCjK6Stt "I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of hard work.")
---

I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping others in need.

---
| [](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c5ad5c9191e64ba790bd775a579dcc83&_e=beB3FyUxgZCQtvzHtnLi0K9zHEw1fsEbzwr3yY_vQLSqCOOQiQ2h0-4bHp07G9FrSGRCGgpZj5yAOiYvruhQn1sTnElMEJJXgA84_Kypd1J8XFksP5W8A4cbU2RF2FMLHnEe1x2gk2BDAjfAzrBOliX3SCLpq073Qrt9LEmBMQkATyHQc7B-dPdioH8gcy8eKR7dW4VvImS14BBkdF63I0417j-aSdTNFn_z2Q-b-5xND6cUAb8j-g13QuSMYQ5MVdj3fSa1gYQexbvtvhN4Kr6NC4m4xX26dhFcvau45Igfzzb0iP_13oiUXfixiX3SD2ByphQQAk8dYBogL1H30aDF3kFPgV_1SAZMAxMsis-K90Zl7tjcmSOKxT7Q5Dkm-WWjtEh8pyPLIyC-ZrvMDRJBZMAdEzkfziejR3yqZzUIYXqIN95irSPEeJZ9cVmB "I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College")
---

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.

---
| [](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c5ad5c9191e64ba790bd775a579dcc83&_e=beB3FyUxgZCQtvzHtnLi0K9zHEw1fsEbzwr3yY_vQLSqCOOQiQ2h0-4bHp07G9FrSGRCGgpZj5yAOiYvruhQn1sTnElMEJJXgA84_Kypd1J8XFksP5W8A4cbU2RF2FMLHnEe1x2gk2BDAjfAzrBOliX3SCLpq073Qrt9LEmBMQkATyHQc7B-dPdioH8gcy8eKR7dW4VvImS14BBkdF63I0417j-aSdTNFn_z2Q-b-5xND6cUAb8j-g13QuSMYQ5MVdj3fSa1gYQexbvtvhN4Kr6NC4m4xX26dhFcvau45IiPwP6Q5bnkOiGO_xHbQgpwlzCWPlF1M8ZsHgsjRa0NJdaW6lvdLMWdK3qNdMkT4agev9wqwGPTeyMtGdO1MvuvsLpiccr466pcQzGheE0Y1PHb_BWcLuVWCsA4Mi7paOruKWT1mRNWax8Hmk8zAhP0 "I married my high school sweetheart Scotty")
---

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever, Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty's side.

---
| [](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c5ad5c9191e64ba790bd775a579dcc83&_e=beB3FyUxgZCQtvzHtnLi0K9zHEw1fsEbzwr3yY_vQLSqCOOQiQ2h0-4bHp07G9FrSGRCGgpZj5yAOiYvruhQn1sTnElMEJJXgA84_Kypd1J8XFksP5W8A4cbU2RF2FMLHnEe1x2gk2BDAjfAzrBOliX3SCLpq073Qrt9LEmBMQkATyHQc7B-dPdioH8gcy8eKR7dW4VvImS14BBkdF63I0417j-aSdTNFn_z2Q-b-5xND6cUAb8j-g13QuSMYQ5MVdj3fSa1gYQexbvtvhN4Kr6NC4m4xX26dhFcvau45IhHR1igF-1ZXgVdl4wMF_1PV8hq3yM7mKYV3QA47e7C7cbeMFySofOrnN3_wbpvr-YPPdskTunJ5dvRMwTv7vvcfGX39mTBBqg4GDBYUOe-hKYZ0xfQUlVmXW92TEI7BMO_JQvVUZffCYj9DO5yyEB9 "Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq")
---

When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on the spot, consenting to Scotty's immediate discharge from the Army.
_**I refused. **_
Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

---
| [](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c5ad5c9191e64ba790bd775a579dcc83&_e=beB3FyUxgZCQtvzHtnLi0K9zHEw1fsEbzwr3yY_vQLSqCOOQiQ2h0-4bHp07G9FrSGRCGgpZj5yAOiYvruhQn1sTnElMEJJXgA84_Kypd1J8XFksP5W8A4cbU2RF2FMLHnEe1x2gk2BDAjfAzrBOliX3SCLpq073Qrt9LEmBMQkATyHQc7B-dPdioH8gcy8eKR7dW4VvImS14BBkdF63I0417j-aSdTNFn_z2Q-b-5xND6cUAb8j-g13QuSMYQ5MVdj3fSa1gYQexbvtvhN4Kr6NC4m4xX26dhFcvau45IgE0a9rMTZrEWJPg99xkFqwXaG8vO72PNygsL8ydOex7serP5ALidC3FFAJah2N0JUvD8IagWFt0z4kLwk05mSA2s3qLIJeY0ntfuaXF7OfgF0QAt3arxeHhxmsyFbaNHwRQ35vjp-2zjovtaqsgpHC "Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.")
---

Scotty went on to serve as America's first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.

---
| [](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c5ad5c9191e64ba790bd775a579dcc83&_e=beB3FyUxgZCQtvzHtnLi0K9zHEw1fsEbzwr3yY_vQLSqCOOQiQ2h0-4bHp07G9FrSGRCGgpZj5yAOiYvruhQn1sTnElMEJJXgA84_Kypd1J8XFksP5W8A4cbU2RF2FMLHnEe1x2gk2BDAjfAzrBOliX3SCLpq073Qrt9LEmBMQkATyHQc7B-dPdioH8gcy8eKR7dW4VvImS14BBkdF63I0417j-aSdTNFn_z2Q-b-5xND6cUAb8j-g13QuSMYQ5MVdj3fSa1gYQexbvtvhN4Kr6NC4m4xX26dhFcvau45IjA90G_R0gEjtuVMW7okrP3S7gIJ7RgIlQr69Ly6YD85houqJFp0CCpvuYUpVed94ViCEWEJXJSooMCMWEgymhcAVO0uImXsvXW4D_1SBrvRTwLdPuhSn8opRP-YXQwxnKyZpzXXY1ZUdAsjsZmFUdd "Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way. ")
---

It's not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way--_and won._

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.

---
| [](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c5ad5c9191e64ba790bd775a579dcc83&_e=beB3FyUxgZCQtvzHtnLi0K9zHEw1fsEbzwr3yY_vQLSqCOOQiQ2h0-4bHp07G9FrSGRCGgpZj5yAOiYvruhQn1sTnElMEJJXgA84_Kypd1J8XFksP5W8A4cbU2RF2FMLHnEe1x2gk2BDAjfAzrBOliX3SCLpq073Qrt9LEmBMQkATyHQc7B-dPdioH8gcy8eKR7dW4VvImS14BBkdF63I0417j-aSdTNFn_z2Q-b-5xND6cUAb8j-g13QuSMYQ5MVdj3fSa1gYQexbvtvhN4Kr6NC4m4xX26dhFcvau45IhTB1Ra4e7VP4gBDbySmPqJXLHduc39AfaBqiEw3BM533x_QLp4-dmTp-yNXnsZaHGF0tnxYf1Af75vUvFuduRekV6vyssUZ6cd1ESq2P7bW6OtjzXR0vy6Xd0CrbwGeJlo78_4GK2oeosy8C0ofenC "I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.")
---

In 2007, we welcomed our first child. While Scotty will never be able to 'see' our children's faces, he's always been an incredible father and hero to our boys.

---
| [](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c5ad5c9191e64ba790bd775a579dcc83&_e=beB3FyUxgZCQtvzHtnLi0K9zHEw1fsEbzwr3yY_vQLSqCOOQiQ2h0-4bHp07G9FrSGRCGgpZj5yAOiYvruhQn1sTnElMEJJXgA84_Kypd1J8XFksP5W8A4cbU2RF2FMLHnEe1x2gk2BDAjfAzrBOliX3SCLpq073Qrt9LEmBMQkATyHQc7B-dPdioH8gcy8eKR7dW4VvImS14BBkdF63I0417j-aSdTNFn_z2Q-b-5xND6cUAb8j-g13QuSMYQ5MVdj3fSa1gYQexbvtvhN4Kr6NC4m4xX26dhFcvau45IgNmY2FoSxFtoGQC93LZas1IClE8xzYkAu4mY5pE5Kv9NAH1pzZtRN6HimOuVZ67HDTJ0I4_Z5GNY9y9TOJkSlbyrSOyOhWOnFMKmI-B-IK97Arv5B1VJWP6kh10ji_wNUYEEKXBVQ-uWaw7g-GMrOv "In 2007, we welcomed our first child.")
---

Now, our family is taking on a new challenge. I'm running for US Senate to help families across the country achieve the American Dream and save our country from Joe Biden and Patty Murray.

I will take the same fight and optimistic spirit I've shown throughout my life to help Washington families secure a better life. I believe that now, more than ever, Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.

---
| [](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c5ad5c9191e64ba790bd775a579dcc83&_e=beB3FyUxgZCQtvzHtnLi0K9zHEw1fsEbzwr3yY_vQLSqCOOQiQ2h0-4bHp07G9FrSGRCGgpZj5yAOiYvruhQn1sTnElMEJJXgA84_Kypd1J8XFksP5W8A4cbU2RF2FMLHnEe1x2gk2BDAjfAzrBOliX3SCLpq073Qrt9LEmBMQkATyHQc7B-dPdioH8gcy8eKR7dW4VvImS14BBkdF63I0417j-aSdTNFn_z2Q-b-5xND6cUAb8j-g13QuSMYQ5MVdj3fSa1gYQexbvtvhN4Kr6NC4m4xX26dhFcvau45IgH0ju-vpgR9T3mBuvoVGzsxdPSsBvloLLrbViFifudzspsUdN-bpi3ZjRIOwilgh4jNBl0juZYj_-Fivnf6BG-d_X6HQ8IwG7_Pz7Z0a15N3gmIY7sTE_lHG-zrZ5hTEqEuHJyqmfluW74SyG5udJB "Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.")
---

My family began this journey in the halls of Walter Reed and we look forward to continuing this journey in the halls of the United States Capitol.

I would love for the next photo in this story to be us winning this race with my family by my side.

We can't do that, however, without your help, friend. _**[So please, can you chip in just a few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we've achieved so far.](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=c5ad5c9191e64ba790bd775a579dcc83&_e=beB3FyUxgZCQtvzHtnLi0K9zHEw1fsEbzwr3yY_vQLSqCOOQiQ2h0-4bHp07G9FrSGRCGgpZj5yAOiYvruhQn1sTnElMEJJXgA84_Kypd1J8XFksP5W8A4cbU2RF2FMLHnEe1x2gk2BDAjfAzrBOliX3SCLpq073Qrt9LEmBMQkATyHQc7B-dPdioH8gcy8eKR7dW4VvImS14BBkdF63I0417j-aSdTNFn_z2Q-b-5xND6cUAb8j-g13QuSMYQ5MVdj3fSa1gYQexbvtvhN4Kr6NC4m4xX26dhFcvau45IhdLYkTvI5JqJdgYTFMP_95PNuk6sBVJyy_PRPuyD4rBH-1TDaQyCqVowrlAHFFDF9k1JG1vuiQecmtJB3GeN-8NnJ15h3Fd13D0NVI3C7PZC4h7bXilGDTkDiIgvZpupbM3945G5FywbKVFKgVUAJz "So please, can you chip in just a few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we’ve achieved so far. During the 2020 redistricting cycle, our organizing efforts resulted in Colorado’s Independent Congressional Redistricting Commission ensuring that the Latino community had an opportunity to elect a candidate of their choice by creating the new 8th congressional district with the highest percentage of Latinos of any congressional district in the state.

We can no longer let this age-old system eradicate the power of diversity.

name: Reclaiming American Freedom
subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. This sponsored message from Reclaiming American Freedom is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=94d0b5de3c284112b46bcd4ed11e364c&_e=jgQrcPvvz5JWb4lSS3M8b7EaeVh_r2YLuODBF_Zy4cxcnZzmAwQzbXWeMSxKfOLcDjtlrHPLJbcqO4ZH-UL2fA1azqPeofLrlgcTPfWD3WkGJTsJqLo04xTEYjS229CQutYkwVaTtOvBVbCCJRnTeFTqrjKKYTotONu0cg9gtponwfoHq-Qh6Ae_yQI88RtTghCZpo3_49PfLD6ZvRnh-2pntp58xPDG2ZaWsXsMg8XUnNmjpX2WaQxSdXR8Q-KP63de7K-jHVQhGtHVisESFFbTRx57MlblwAt-xaKg2G2eOAfCr9nRghiILgbkgDTAEvlcbMeO68l07EIapvhY9bFvayS6yGczsYEkvh85bv2x5yimQX5a1pscTenDGyIcUvVOivs5hmQ4YL8u-u4Jiw%3D%3D) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=94d0b5de3c284112b46bcd4ed11e364c&_e=jgQrcPvvz5JWb4lSS3M8b7EaeVh_r2YLuODBF_Zy4cxcnZzmAwQzbXWeMSxKfOLcDjtlrHPLJbcqO4ZH-UL2fA1azqPeofLrlgcTPfWD3WkGJTsJqLo04xTEYjS229CQutYkwVaTtOvBVbCCJRnTeFTqrjKKYTotONu0cg9gtponwfoHq-Qh6Ae_yQI88RtTghCZpo3_49PfLD6ZvRnh-2pntp58xPDG2ZaWsXsMg8UO-K3XPHWHRP9tWwcchEIZchABqHumGwvnGSKAak8nmHqbT6K-jhfgYoz654PCeW1x45pJSuF11llBuinKGC7Z6q6EU87xj18fc2rLdvxqmPvTPX01EyM1uYbpIQXrKluPXKkgbRwbSu4_-Qk9kYomvxQbbf8UtuT1Op1E_bUfow%3D%3D)** For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale’s Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=94d0b5de3c284112b46bcd4ed11e364c&_e=jgQrcPvvz5JWb4lSS3M8b7EaeVh_r2YLuODBF_Zy4cxcnZzmAwQzbXWeMSxKfOLcDjtlrHPLJbcqO4ZH-UL2fA1azqPeofLrlgcTPfWD3WkGJTsJqLo04xTEYjS229CQutYkwVaTtOvBVbCCJRnTeFTqrjKKYTotONu0cg9gtponwfoHq-Qh6Ae_yQI88RtTghCZpo3_49PfLD6ZvRnh-2pntp58xPDG2ZaWsXsMg8UsdZ_83i_rTpb2wBwH4LaUGokD7e3VvCf4g996liytgL0ibKoRr0iyQANbYjHeKVPLfSgGccHab7Cpg3P0-Cl0yo4bYN8ukzc571OWply7CXZ5wxpo67PcTEV4736vy3erguxLcaOOnSl7D-mNqZOcRtsSbHHgb3-1vAJfsnGisA%3D%3D)** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been “pursuing truth and defending liberty.” Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
---

Friend,
Senator James Lankford is drawing a connection to the passing of a deeply flawed, extreme piece of legislation restricting women's rights with rain falling as a sign of God’s blessing.”
The growing trend of James Lankford abusing his own interpretation of faith to gain the trust of his constituents goes hand-in-hand with the extreme government overreach that he is forcing on others.
This abuse of power and extreme ideology is what is driving division in our nation. Will you contribute $5, or even $10 now to fight against harmful rhetoric ? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ruerainiln]
This bill, lacking both empathy and compassion, has brought suffering to thousands of women in our state, as similar bills have across our nation. The rain he is referring to was responsible for hundreds of farmers losing crops and income. This was no act of God, but a poor argument from a failing Senator, whose only hope is to misuse religion for his own personal gain.
85% of Americans support reasonable access to reproductive health services – access that the Oklahoma bill denies. Will you take action to support the protection of women's healthcare? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ruerainiln]
He is not the first elected official throughout history to abuse religious views in this way, but it is another shameful example of a Senator who has become a mouthpiece for divisive factions and political pandering.
The fact is, women are now suffering, Oklahoma is still in a drought, and elected officials like James Lankford must be voted out this November.
Let's get to work!
Madison Horn

In Florida we won 35 school board races. In total, the GOP flipped 5 counties with left-majority school boards. Up north both of our candidates in Duval County won their elections. Down south, both 1776 Project PAC endorsed candidates in Miami Dade County won their elections, flipping the school board. Miami Dade is now the largest county in America with a red-majority. Across the state, all three of our endorsed candidates in Sarasota County won their elections. We flipped the board from a 3-2 liberal majority to 4-1 conservative. The [same Sarasota School Board](https://substack.com/redirect/28d7d4d3-af26-45df-b258-d33836417521?r=1hvr60) where a member was recently exposed for saying "here in Florida, there are school board members that are woke. We are working from the best strategic spot because we're working from the inside."

In other news, Florida Governor Ron DeSantis suspended four Broward School Board Members [after the Parkland report](https://substack.com/redirect/66f34e2f-a15e-4c68-a4fa-dcb70f6262b4?r=1hvr60) was released. DeSantis's actions come due to misuse of authority, neglect of duty, and incompetence. Post-Florida, protecting parental rights is still in our top interest. As we keep seeing in recent elections, education is the force driving voters to the polls. Since the Florida school board victories late last month, more than 300 candidates have applied for endorsement from 1776 Project PAC. Though we are not talking to any new candidates for the rest of the 2022 cycle, stay tuned for more victories as we close in on November.

**Teacher Talk**
Instead of welcoming students on the first day of school, teachers in [Seattle Public Schools](https://substack.com/redirect/9f1cc93d-062f-4aec-a8be-ca1f08c2151f?r=1hvr60) went on strike. The results of their actions are delaying learning and punishing students. Neither are productive, it also seems that the teachers hate working. Despite the fact that they are only working 9 or 10 months of the year, they have every holiday off and then some, they got a one year paid vacation during COVID, apparently it's still too much.
Many reports are saying COVID learning changes have caused students to fall behind by two full years of academic instruction. Real learning has significantly declined, students are the ones that end up hurting from lack of structure and engagement. Instead of teachers working to improve the quality of learning for students, one district required ['Whiteness Theory'](https://substack.com/redirect/d7813fea-f27e-4560-aa33-032cb10b400f?r=1hvr60) teacher training.
Other districts in states around the country are also scrambling to find and keep enough teachers to lead their classrooms. One answer for the lack of personnel could be discrimination. Multiple recent reports of hiring practices where candidates are rejected for their religion or politics have whistleblowers sounding the alarm. Project Veritas recently [released footage](https://substack.com/redirect/d392f60a-1976-4858-aff7-298d99adad47?r=1hvr60) of a Connecticut Public Schools Assistant Principal admitting to discriminating against Catholic teachers applying at his school.
[Follow us on Twitter](https://substack.com/redirect/5f98b61e-9fd7-45ef-a8ad-1339c3515e3a?r=1hvr60)
**One County at a Time**
Our work across the country is paying off, in May we won 15 school board races in Texas. Last month a Texas school board that we flipped banned CRT and gender ideology. Parents started a revolution, but it takes everyone doing their part: registering to vote on time, reading up on local school board candidates, and making it out on election day. Together we will continue the nationwide trend of parents pushing back against woke education and taking back control of their public schools.

Peter,

I wanted to take a few minutes today to tell you a little bit about myself, my life story, and what's never going to change. **__My Upbringing__**
I was raised in Zachary, Louisiana where I was taught the values I live by today by my mother and father. Those same values that I fight for each and every single day to protect. Values like hard work, dedication, and putting God and family first in everything.

[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61364904:6eSLc3VND:m:1:3253819041:38243B5EAD0F9A11998C7522BFE0B387:r)
After high school, I attended Vanderbilt University, graduated, and then went on to receive my law degree at the University of Virginia. I tell you that so you know that I know a little more about law than the average pink-haired worker would like you to believe.

**__So, what 'd I do after college?__**
I was elected to five terms as State Treasurer where I managed the state's $10.6 billion investment portfolios. I also oversaw local and state bond issues and returned millions of dollars in unclaimed property each year. Before I was Treasurer, I served as Secretary of the Department of Revenue, Special Counsel to Governor Roemer, and Secretary of Governor Roemer's Cabinet.

[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61364904:6eSLc3VND:m:1:3253819041:38243B5EAD0F9A11998C7522BFE0B387:r)
Then, I got my biggest call. **The call to help the people of Louisiana and America.**

**_Time as U.S. Senator of Louisiana_**
I was elected to the U.S. Senate in 2016 after being endorsed by none other than President Donald J. Trump. I serve on the Appropriations, Banking, Housing and Urban Affairs, Budget, Judiciary, and Small Business and Entrepreneurship committees in the U.S. Senate. I serve as the Ranking Member on the Subcommittee of Energy and Water Development for the Appropriations Committee, the Ranking Member on the Subcommittee of Federal Courts for the Judiciary Committee, and the Ranking Member on the Subcommittee of Economic Policy for the Banking Committee.

[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61364904:6eSLc3VND:m:1:3253819041:38243B5EAD0F9A11998C7522BFE0B387:r)
Every day for me is a new challenge, another day to serve the people of Louisiana, and another day to fight for our conservative values. You see, I'm always going to be **100% PRO-LIFE, PRO-GUN****,** and **PRO-FREEDOM**. That's not going to change regardless of what the Neo-Socialist Left throws at me and you can write that down and take it home to mama.

**I 'm going to fight for your rights, your freedoms, and for a better future for our children. **

That won't change, I'd rather drink weedkiller than let the Socialist Left Agenda poison this country that we know and love so much.

**[So, now that I've given you my story in a nutshell, I'm going to humbly ask for your support. I've got two Left-of-Lenin opponents running to defeat me because Nancy Pelosi likes me about as much as a cat likes swimming. I need you to rush whatever you're able below to make sure I have the resources necessary to fight for you and defend our nation.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61364904:6eSLc3VND:m:1:3253819041:38243B5EAD0F9A11998C7522BFE0B387:r)** | [**DONATE $500**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61364905:6eSLc3VND:m:1:3253819041:38243B5EAD0F9A11998C7522BFE0B387:r)

A few weeks ago, we received an unexpected email from Front, the
company that manages all inbound and outbound email for the team
here at the Babylon Bee, informing us that they had terminated
our account, effective immediately.

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWxdxS3hxN

Fellow
American,

We knew
it was just a matter of time before another woke company canceled
us... but we didn't see this one coming.

A few
weeks ago, we received an unexpected email from Front, the
company that manages all inbound and outbound email for the team
here at the Babylon Bee, informing us that they had terminated
our account, effective immediately.

Sure
enough, moments later, we were unable to send or receive email.

For weeks
afterwards, our team scrambled. We're a company spread across
multiple cities, so email is essential to our operation. Needless
to say, this one hurt. Front decided to drop the bomb on us in
whatever way would disrupt us the most, and they succeeded.

But why
would they do such a thing?

By now,
I'm sure you have a good guess.

It
probably comes as no surprise that Front is run by a group of
woke, left-wing tech elitists. Just like Twitter, Facebook, The
New York Times, Snopes, and the many other companies that have
attacked us, they simply can't abide satire that dares to mock
their left-wing orthodoxy.

So they
orchestrated their attack to do the most damage they possibly
could.

We've
been through attacks like this before, and we know that there are
more coming - which is why I'm reaching out to free speech-loving
friends like you who value good satire, asking you to become a
paid subscriber of the Babylon Bee today.

Become a
Subscriber Today >>

For years
now, we've been building our support base in an effort to become
"cancel-proof" - so that radical companies like Front can't pull
the rug out from under us like this.

We've
come a long way, but as this episode proved, we're still
vulnerable.

You can
help with your subscription today. And remember - you won't just
be standing with the Bee; you'll be standing up for free speech
of all kinds online, and showing left-wing elitists that they can
try to censor free thinkers like us, but the truth will always
win out.

If you're
familiar with the Babylon Bee, you know that we're no strangers
to this sort of treatment. We've been canceled, censored,
shadow-banned, locked out, and kicked off by more left-wing
operations than I can count, for no other reason than that the
woke just can't take a joke.

As a
matter of fact, we've been locked out of our Twitter account for
the past three months because we refuse to delete our satirical
post honoring transgender Biden appointee Dr. Rachel Levine as
our "Man of the Year."

But
thanks to our network of subscribers, we can weather these storms
better than ever before. Thanks to thousands of friends just like
you who see the value of investing in free speech and good
satire, we're still pushing forward.

But
today, I'm asking you to join us. If you've been on the fence,
now really is the time. Don't wait until our next cancellation.
Please help us build resiliency today by becoming a subscriber.

Our goal
is quite simple: to become the Obi Wan Kenobi of the digital
world.

To
paraphrase the great sage himself, with friends like you united
behind us, the woke tech elites can't win. They can try to strike
us down, but we will become more powerful than they could
possibly imagine.

Join the
rebellion today.

body:
Mark Kelly’s race in Arizona will be close–but he can win. | | | [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953wqcJuDX2HRji8zceUQ74uMPyXwArFUhhEylhu27HuuFZPbUWWTdGH4838vBzdyazPkgGfSEI9dOrau8XGHCENJ6Je06YUb2AtP8-YN1Byq9GBTg8785gsbQ_ffAWduYcqzV7pjEnkpIsZGmd65KYI6_Yfq5IW3Qckt0gyuRwxJEo4vxTnU8b8otdXcMy7G3QPQfWMpU0dRZZMiYemk7egy-7mznBlWLPaL6I-NLstN5CcYall2rW2_jW9pPzfek7G0Gb-sNthDaiU-MhI3FAEEpmMkxIZLAnNykF_xrudtu-CCcrPbc9Y-o6JAXKGiogIBqyBRpmyOC9Gat84klvyl/3po/IBDB3rlCTZO3oH42QXFaQw/h0/VfGCO9NChdfM8LxmkvcRA0SaMTAm0oh28MlHdFlKtGs)
Peter, Kyrsten Sinema’s constant obstruction has put Democrats in a real tough position this year – and that applies especially to her home state colleague Mark Kelly. The good news is that Kelly has a slight lead over extremist MAGA-Republican Blake Masters in the polls, but we can’t afford this race to be a toss up. [**Can you send Kelly a few dollars to ensure we keep our Democratic majority in the Senate? >>**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953wqcJuDX2HRji8zceUQ74uMGebOcSApzvnNbdU3lM0CwbNxfn92Lt5CBNu4WZgpCGSnDwLLWFFcPMrgAJrSjLZSrelPKGIy-BMV1N7GuX9tOdIzz1_dRwKmLkbaSQXc8x2h2ys8tKoyrDAifxLnUxt-hIL6XqvtaJviVHBofllScgEcPTKAGV8G-hrVPvl1VPjNK-XLqIV-6cZNbgJm5OecWuBxVCMKiux4uSIIaVWyg-LMEnyVxeG8n9IvSty0DdPjafCfKjX5-x_rjXv3-PD2gC4G8JbsbSbk3TZ8R-tGRxGUErmtL5DFqcKyvuJrl-E/3po/IBDB3rlCTZO3oH42QXFaQw/h1/msdf7DWd3oSQ_jP2ESdc_enYA9S-JtPEAIJVePrHKCk)
Masters is dangerous – he’s promoted Trump’s election conspiracies and is running on a platform of fear mongering and misinformation. And Republicans are spending millions of dollars to help him beat Mark Kelly. Mark Kelly has been hamstrung more than most by Sinema’s constant obstruction – it’s put him in a terrible position of having to account for his Arizona colleague’s positions, and the Republicans have used Sinema’s own words to attack Kelly. | | Mining Journal, Letter to the Editor Sept. 22, 2022 by Scott Emerson I am voting for Dr. Bob Lorinser for Congress because knowing him for a very long time has revealed his true character. I know he actually lives here. I know about his high ethical standards. I know how he has always been a man dedicated to service for others and to something greater than himself. I know of his intelligence, compassion, balanced wisdom and fearless independence in critical decision making. I know how he speaks truth to power, to oppose bureaucratic bungling. I know how he is always armed with facts, science and compelling logic. I know we now have a good shot at firing the MAGA robot currently holding our congressional seat, and replacing that with an independent, free thinker, Dr. Bob Lorinser.
Dr. Lorinser and I worked for over 20 years as attending physicians together treating critically ill patients at our regional hospital here in Marquette. He was a doc who was always the patients advocate, possessed great diagnostic ability, and always kept himself up to date with the latest medical science. Indeed, a role model for other physicians.
During my career as an emergency physician, I noticed especially on those ragged, edgy, overwhelming nights when our ER was in crisis mode, how Dr. Bob responded as an efficient, cool-headed team member leading with his heart in service to others. We also served together on multiple advisory committees providing input based on our clinical experiences to hospital administration on how to improve quality, efficiency and safety of all patient care. Dr. Lorinser courageously resisted and railed against the bureaucracy every time that it threatened the highest standards of any patient’s care. Dr. Lorinser believes as I do that the physician and patient relationship is a very private and complex sacred space created in service to the patient and ensuring the patient’s freedom of choice in medical decisions. The government’s attempt to intrude into this sacred space and remove these freedoms, is them trying to practice medicine without a license or medical education.
Dr. Bob knows the power of public health, and that an ounce of prevention can eliminate many chronic diseases, the suffering that these cause, as well as heading off a huge and growing disease care expense for our country. These are the reasons you should also vote for Bob Lorinser for Congress.
SCOTT EMERSONMarquette

Mining Journal, Letter to the Editor Sept. 22, 2022 by Scott Emerson
I am voting for Dr. Bob Lorinser for Congress because knowing him for a very long time has revealed his true character. I know he actually lives here. I know about his high ethical standards. I know how he has always been a man dedicated to service for others and to something greater than himself.
I know of his intelligence, compassion, balanced wisdom and fearless independence in critical decision making. I know how he speaks truth to power, to oppose bureaucratic bungling. I know how he is always armed with facts, science and compelling logic.
I know we now have a good shot at firing the MAGA robot currently holding our congressional seat, and replacing that with an independent, free thinker, Dr. Bob Lorinser.
Dr. Lorinser and I worked for over 20 years as attending physicians together treating critically ill patients at our regional hospital here in Marquette. He was a doc who was always the patients advocate, possessed great diagnostic ability, and always kept himself up to date with the latest medical science. Indeed, a role model for other physicians.
During my career as an emergency physician, I noticed especially on those ragged, edgy, overwhelming nights when our ER was in crisis mode, how Dr. Bob responded as an efficient, cool-headed team member leading with his heart in service to others.
We also served together on multiple advisory committees providing input based on our clinical experiences to hospital administration on how to improve quality, efficiency and safety of all patient care. Dr. Lorinser courageously resisted and railed against the bureaucracy every time that it threatened the highest standards of any patient’s care.
Dr. Lorinser believes as I do that the physician and patient relationship is a very private and complex sacred space created in service to the patient and ensuring the patient’s freedom of choice in medical decisions. The government’s attempt to intrude into this sacred space and remove these freedoms, is them trying to practice medicine without a license or medical education.
Dr. Bob knows the power of public health, and that an ounce of prevention can eliminate many chronic diseases, the suffering that these cause, as well as heading off a huge and growing disease care expense for our country.
These are the reasons you should also vote for Bob Lorinser for Congress.
SCOTT EMERSON
Marquette

| | Don't just take it from us, Scott Gryder has what it takes to defeat Democratic Rep. Lauren Underwood in November! But he needs your help to do it. Earlier this month, Illinois political reporter Patrick Pfingsten shared that he believes IL-14 is the [most likely district to flip in Illinois](http://firepit.campstrategic.com/go/1/ece42c7afc6d70999c32df07ccef91c9/41753/e7696184c0a7db29/fa73733604373268c3d6b838967d376c/41753) on Election Day. **"...the question was about which incumbent was most likely to lose, and I think the answer remains Lauren Underwood."** The people of our district are seeing the harm that she has done to Illinois families, and they are ready for change. Scott will deliver for Illinoisans by lowering taxes, reducing costs, and putting the people of this district first. [_Your donation of $500, $250, $100, or even $50, will help Scott get his conservative, common-sense message out to voters and turn IL-14 red._](http://firepit.campstrategic.com/go/1/ece42c7afc6d70999c32df07ccef91c9/41753/e7696184c0a7db29/198de57d9ae5fb32c3d6b838967d376c/41753) Any donation you are able to give is appreciated.
