body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/mspolicy/leadershipacademy-8132628?e=5703353baa)
---
| |
---
|
Dear #VALUE!,

Earlier this year, Mississippi cut the state income tax, giving 1.1 million Mississippi workers a tax break. **The Mississippi Center for Public Policy has now received a national award in recognition of our role in making this historic tax cut happen.**
---
|
---
| _**The Mississippi Center for Public Policy staff received two awards from the State Policy Network. **_
---
| The State Policy Network, which gave out the awards at their annual meeting in Atlanta, supports a movement of over 60 independent think tanks across America. MCPP received the award jointly with Empower Mississippi.

**Our award, for the _Biggest Win for Freedom,_ shows that the reform agenda we are helping deliver in Mississippi is getting national recognition.**

Mississippi has been one of the poorest states in America for as long as anyone can remember. Cutting the state income tax will encourage growth in our state and put Mississippi on the right path.

The Award event got even better, however. **In recognition of our effort to overturn the Biden administration’s vaccine mandate our litigation division, the Mississippi Justice Institute, won the _SPN Network Award_.**
---
|
---
| | | _**Aaron Rice celebrates overturning the Biden mandate. **_
---

---
We were given the award jointly with a number of other think tanks, including the Texan Public Policy Foundation and Louisiana’s Pelican Institute.

Speaking at the SPN Award event in Atlanta, Douglas Carswell, our President & CEO said, "These awards show that MCPP is driving real change in Mississippi. We now need to focus on achieving real change in education and healthcare, too."
|
---
| _**Douglas Carswell gives his speech after receiving the Biggest Win for Freedom Award. **_

Jeff Shrader is on board
| | | |
---
---
|
# Sheriff Shrader Endorsement
---
|
---
| | |
---|---
|
Today, Erik Aadland, CD7 Republican candidate for Congress, announces a formal endorsement from Jefferson County Sheriff Jeff Shrader.

Sheriff Jeff Shrader began his career with the Jefferson County Sheriff's Office in 1984 as a deputy assigned to the county jail. Prior to being elected sheriff in 2014,

Sheriff Shrader oversaw operations as chief of each of the four major divisions of the Sheriff's Office. He is a graduate of the FBI National Academy and the National Executive Institute, an executive development program for the largest law enforcement agencies in the country.

Sheriff Shrader has proactively led the 825 men and women of the JCSO and the nearly 300 volunteers who provide valuable support to the sheriff's office's mission. He has also been effective in administering the organization's $110 million budget, continuously seeking ways to improve the agency's services and efficiencies.

Sheriff Shrader is involved in many professional organizations, serving as a board member for County Sheriffs of Colorado (CSOC) and as an active member of Major County Sheriffs of America (MCSA). In the spring of 2019, he was invited to serve on Governor Polis' COVID Task Force as a respected member and representative of law enforcement
---
| In a statement sent to Erik Aadland's campaign, Sheriff Shrader said:
"It was easy for me to endorse Erik Aadland for Congress. One of Erik's top priorities is keeping Coloradans safe by attacking the rise in crime that has impacted so many CD7 constituents. I have watched Colorado become a more dangerous state due to liberal policies. I believe Erik will go to Washington and fight against the legislation that has harmed far too many families. I wholeheartedly support Erik and know he is the right person for this prominent position. "
---
| |
---
---
|
# Erik's Remarks
---
| |
---
|
---
| "I am honored to have Sheriff Shrader's endorsement. Sheriff Shrader has bravely shown what it takes to properly serve and protect the people of Jefferson County, just as I hope to soon serve and protect the constituents of CD7. Sheriff Shrader has always put the needs of his constituents first and has certainly made great strides in keeping Jefferson County safe. I am grateful for Sheriff Shrader's unwavering loyalty to Colorado and will work to emulate his strength and leadership in Washington. "
---

---

## About Erik
---
| |
---
| Jefferson County resident Erik Aadland is a West Point graduate and a twice-decorated Bronze Star veteran--one for valor--from his time in Iraq and Afghanistan. Concluding his army career in 2011 as a Captain, he pursued a career in the oil and natural gas industry with his work culminating as a project manager directing the onshore construction of the Leviathan Project in Dor, Israel. This project resulted in Israel being energy-independent and a net exporter of natural gas. Erik holds a master's degree in the field of psychology. He is a devoted husband and proud father of three children.

[1]Stacey Abrams for Governor

Hi Derek, it’s
Stacey’s dad, Reverend Robert Abrams.

I’m going door to door to challenge people to get out and vote as soon as
polls open on October 17th. [ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/3387?refcode=sa_em_220922_B1_Dad_S1_T1_RRA_SL&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1002&akid=9400%2E1862389%2Eamev_M ]But first, will you join me in supporting
my daughter Stacey’s campaign for Governor of Georgia? Anything you can
give — $25 or even $5 — will make a real
difference in the final stretch of her campaign.

[ Stacey's ]Stacey's dad, Reverend Robert Abrams, talking to voters

When Stacey was a little girl, we made sure service was a way of life for
our children. We were adamant that she and her siblings work to improve
the community around them — even when we didn’t have much ourselves.

And ever since then, Stacey has dedicated her life to public service.

As a legislator and leader, she spent her career serving the community by
fighting for voting rights, access to health care, the opportunity to
thrive and so much more.

But right now, she’s up against one of the architects of modern-day voter
suppression — Brian Kemp.

Kemp has made it easier for bad actors to frivolously challenge voters’
eligibility. He has restricted voting drop boxes and made voting by mail
more difficult. He even made it illegal to hand out water to voters
waiting in long lines.

Brian Kemp knows the momentum is against him, so he’s doing everything in
his power to try to suppress voters.

That’s why I’m working with my daughter, Stacey Abrams, to elect her as
the next governor of Georgia. And I need your support today!

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/3387?refcode=sa_em_220922_B1_Dad_S1_T1_RRA_SL&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1003&akid=9400%2E1862389%2Eamev_M ]Starting right now, we ALL need to do our part to fight against voter
suppression and send my daughter to the governor’s mansion. Can you chip
in $5 now to mobilize voters to the polls, win in November,
and make sure Stacey can get to work for Georgians?

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/3387?refcode=sa_em_220922_B1_Dad_S1_T1_RRA_SL&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1004&akid=9400%2E1862389%2Eamev_M ]DONATE

Reverend Robert Abrams

Fellow American, We knew it was just a matter of time before another woke company canceled us... but we didn't see this one coming. A few weeks ago, we received an unexpected email from Front, the company that manages all inbound and outbound email for the team here at the Babylon Bee, informing us that they had terminated our account, effective immediately. Sure enough, moments later, we were unable to send or receive email. For weeks afterwards, our team scrambled. We're a company spread across multiple cities, so email is essential to our operation. Needless to say, this one hurt. Front decided to drop the bomb on us in whatever way would disrupt us the most, and they succeeded. But _why_ would they do such a thing? By now, I'm sure you have a good guess. It probably comes as no surprise that Front is run by a group of woke, left-wing tech elitists. Just like Twitter, Facebook, _The New York Times_ , Snopes, and the many other companies that have attacked us, they simply can't abide satire that dares to mock their left-wing orthodoxy. So they orchestrated their attack to do the most damage they possibly could. [**We 've been through attacks like this before, and we know that there are more coming -- which is why I'm reaching out to free speech-loving friends like you who value good satire, asking you to become a paid subscriber of the Babylon Bee today.**](http://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=6d1925dcb7514d8c94ae85ef026de1a3&_e=Au7MnHvzr66QXkDla4ptBZJVY178qiQ0U493XgSrxODTT-dvo6-EKepX48INJNvJMP1Gbh2lhTvE_prhRYyoewKD_4bJCdXQyv-2tzCLMQ41bp_TDENejt0KBb6zc12jD6jA2h9j3o4uklfkTHiihnU5fDTueqn-lBPBc-ertgK4hn-v366MiPH-dwTNVDM5dAfjhHErptDpjSwiP1BqF8FQTkEoCYsVCRIWm4aJdRQ%3D)

For years now, we've been building our support base in an effort to become "cancel-proof" -- so that radical companies like Front can't pull the rug out from under us like this. We've come a long way, but as this episode proved, we're still vulnerable. [**You can help with your subscription today**.](http://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=6d1925dcb7514d8c94ae85ef026de1a3&_e=Au7MnHvzr66QXkDla4ptBZJVY178qiQ0U493XgSrxODTT-dvo6-EKepX48INJNvJMP1Gbh2lhTvE_prhRYyoe-9L5PsKlrV_iW-A0DDi0NDKw-CqOqeaIIaRXOGSOBstk40X_WmCsJO5aegffNNerIvat3xZQfsRKSmrj3HtKlexHOUXUgp1R8NiXMt_E_REK455LZovSm-CO6TsrjA1IkC5azUoI0Wu1v3OeAi1a0I%3D) And remember -- you won't just be standing with the Bee; you'll be standing up for free speech of all kinds online, and showing left-wing elitists that they can try to censor free thinkers like us, but the truth will always win out. If you're familiar with the Babylon Bee, you know that we're no strangers to this sort of treatment. We've been canceled, censored, shadow-banned, locked out, and kicked off by more left-wing operations than I can count, for no other reason than that the woke just can't take a joke. As a matter of fact, we've been locked out of our Twitter account for the past three months because we refuse to delete our satirical post honoring transgender Biden appointee Dr. Rachel Levine as our "Man of the Year." But thanks to our network of subscribers, we can weather these storms better than ever before. Thanks to thousands of friends just like you who see the value of investing in free speech and good satire, we're still pushing forward. [**But today, I'm asking you to join us. If you've been on the fence, now really is the time. Don't wait until our next cancellation. To paraphrase the great sage himself, with friends like you united behind us, the woke tech elites can't win. So far, conservative groups have spent a whopping $161 million on 31 toss up House races during the general election.

This is a longer email than usual but for the past months, I have become the #1 target of the Left, the liberal biased media, and Big Tech giants like Facebook, Twitter, and YouTube.

body:
Thank you for being on this team.
#
Hey Derek, I’m going to get personal real quick... and don’t mind if I get a little misty-eyed while I tell you about this. 🥲
Something you might not know is that I ran for this same U.S. Senate seat in 2016. We didn’t even win the primary, but I’m still so proud of that campaign we ran together.
Deciding to run for office, especially for a seat as important as this one, can be a difficult decision. Even among my family, I made sure Gisele + the kids were on board with this, because we knew it wouldn't be easy.
The press scrutinizes every move I (and even my family) make. The GOP continues to spend millions of dollars on ads that lie about who I am + what I stand for. Even Dr. Oz has used the fact that I had a life-threatening stroke against me — something no legit doctor would do, btw.
But despite politics being “icky and dirty,” as Gisele would say, you’ve been there by my side. And that means more than you will ever know, Derek.
Every single time one of yinz or youse chips in, it’s a reminder that this campaign is truly people-powered by all 67-counties. Together, we’ve built a record-breaking grassroots movement. And because of your support, I know that we’re going to make a real difference for working families everywhere this November.
**[Which is why I have to ask: Can I count on you to make your first $5 donation today? Our campaign wouldn’t be here breaking records if it wasn’t for folks like you chipping in when you can.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220922-1?amount=5&refcode=em20220922-7340&refcode2=7340_434096_NhcEbl&akid=7340%2E434096%2ENhcEbl)**
**[Contribute](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220922-1?amount=5&refcode=em20220922-7340&refcode2=7340_434096_NhcEbl&akid=7340%2E434096%2ENhcEbl)**
At the end of the month, when my finance team submits our final quarterly finance report of this election, I would be honored to know your name is on it, Derek.
But even if you can’t give right now, know that I am so proud to have your support. I hope I make you proud in return.
— John ❤️
John Fetterman
Lieutenant Governor of Pennsylvania
Democratic Nominee for U.S. Senate

Friend, I’ll get straight to the point.
---
We have less than 50 days to ensure we’re in the best possible position to END Pelosi’s majority.
---
**But that all rests on a VICTORY here in Texas’ brand new 38th congressional district – the 1 FINAL seat to flip the House.**
---
**_And according to the most recent polls, the race for control of the House is a _50-50 TOSS-UP._ _**
---
Come Election Day, I refuse to look back and think what more I could’ve done. That’s why I’m giving these final weeks of the race everything I’ve got.
---
**But as it stands, we’re on pace to MISS our final FEC quarterly deadline by roughly $39,000.**
---

Wonder why??

The first was back in March 2021, when Michigan's dishonest Secretary of State Jocelyn Benson[ ](https://rightstrategies.us/email/l/0Qky4uvr892tttSpAxJb8920tw/00K8vh9qtTBu3SkxVLzVRQ/fXriBLEpgKcTLJTHLA8928927A)was found to be in violation of Michigan election law by Michigan Judge Christopher Murray. Now we find out that #BadBenson is one of the architects behind the "Zuckerbucks" scheme that allowed thousands of "mules" to stuff ballot boxes all over Michigan.

Folks this has got to stop!

**We must restore confidence in our election systems.**

We must do it for our children and our grandchildren, so that they may inherit the country we all grew up in and love.

We must elect me as your next HONEST Secretary of State.

Fighting for your freedoms,

Kristina Karamo

_No longer want to receive emails from Andy Barr for Congress? You may [unsubscribe dpwillis67@gmail.com here](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/e/encryptedUnsubscribe?_r=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_s=70e7fcaeacfe4414820e0394b921c71f&_t=KcpX0l3Wyq6GNVUx5kQLTmvzZ-djmXiUvV7dt2_5PpLlXkJruypZfBV5QTVrp2BfXKYnySzjw1OIc2Y0k33QF-QZLEJ2MeKBzeQU7zSwF5s%3D)._

[](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=70e7fcaeacfe4414820e0394b921c71f&_e=mXtD0OlHSd-NBnGL2uWISWOjd_shL2SyEsuPOKCguByVosB50l8acnlvSEUAx39xM4k1ncUaksSEcJDgbuP8OWuxVTAo_oQxlHHt46joft5kRJ-Zm_VpFPxQPF1J1vI8U8xdeemnS6ozhTPV20siaL_n4cCXp-mBVFv-Px-jCeU997FQZIroMbtxuQYKqVsZQWq4rbF91DIXd8Fcs50BUesDwQxP3TSBayWfaXyHu6hSBn4k9QHZtSECLo0gnl4RYNvbB-ujjWuLVWTrANsNZMRukRK4gbM_J7IqMcW5Vq-qhNdwH9VeH8DQddQU1gSee6KZdLZ4DB0B9wm77_bzu1SjCCeeMjRMLZP4T9LvYTz-j0sj5mk2tLEzXOUQ1xqX)

---
Peter,

When my colleagues see me coming, they joke and say, [**"there’s Barr, so it must be something about horses, bourbon, Toyota, coal, or the University of Kentucky!"**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=70e7fcaeacfe4414820e0394b921c71f&_e=mXtD0OlHSd-NBnGL2uWISWOjd_shL2SyEsuPOKCguByVosB50l8acnlvSEUAx39xM4k1ncUaksSEcJDgbuP8OWuxVTAo_oQxlHHt46joft5kRJ-Zm_VpFPxQPF1J1vI8U8xdeemnS6ozhTPV20siaL_n4cCXp-mBVFv-Px-jCeU997FQZIroMbtxuQYKqVsZQWq4rbF91DIXd8Fcs50BUesDwQxP3TSBayWfaXyHu6jBWosGaojW7wzxS77n2COR8USRTDpjxQucNazJP5ADgAA8FIiCdrns10sKXjU6q3bWqrd0HVsMTDkQCCLltTKtWmFIhK36g1RfU7rD6lIlU450hstmBZCi46u0sooZvW2wKuqr9g-8U4_Ym8PEDQkQ)

_And they’re not wrong..._ I bleed Kentucky through and through. It’s where my family has always been, it’s the place that shaped me into the man I am, and it’s the Commonwealth that I’ve been so blessed to represent in Congress.

Now, towards the end of this email, I’m going to request something from you, but first, I want you to understand who I am, how I became the man I am, and what I’m hoping for my future and the future of my daughters.

Growing up, my sister was diagnosed with juvenile arthritis. Our family had to come together to support her treatment. _This taught me that family is the most important thing, compassion is essential, struggle is inevitable, and perseverance is necessary._

It also showed me the need for high-quality, affordable and accessible healthcare for families - [**which continues to be a top issue for me in Congress.**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=70e7fcaeacfe4414820e0394b921c71f&_e=mXtD0OlHSd-NBnGL2uWISWOjd_shL2SyEsuPOKCguByVosB50l8acnlvSEUAx39xM4k1ncUaksSEcJDgbuP8OWuxVTAo_oQxlHHt46joft5kRJ-Zm_VpFPxQPF1J1vI8U8xdeemnS6ozhTPV20siaL_n4cCXp-mBVFv-Px-jCeU997FQZIroMbtxuQYKqVsZQWq4rbF91DIXd8Fcs50BUesDwQxP3TSBayWfaXyHu6jtWj5n5jGUV4u27RUydMCZsDDStWXDFNeY3IzBAZ6iLNcpBknrs8aqqOP_cUkhbUHri8NfpE2X0AL8fwRtbE9ehzKZgXO98T02QAlhPrnPmObfV2Z1cONOBAO7_e2mjPHmi0almYZB-c0n09O0PlQ5)

My love for Kentucky met my interest in politics when I first interned in Washington in college. The ability to work on and fight for legislative policies that helped conservative causes was so rewarding.

Ultimately, I took a chance and ran for Congress in my hometown of Lexington against an incumbent Democrat and lost by 647 votes in one of the closest races in the country. But I recalled the lessons I learned as a child, and I persevered. Two years later I ran again and I was elected. [**Since being in Congress, I’ve fought hard for issues that actually matter to families like tax cuts, American energy, and affordable, high-quality healthcare options.**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=70e7fcaeacfe4414820e0394b921c71f&_e=mXtD0OlHSd-NBnGL2uWISWOjd_shL2SyEsuPOKCguByVosB50l8acnlvSEUAx39xM4k1ncUaksSEcJDgbuP8OWuxVTAo_oQxlHHt46joft5kRJ-Zm_VpFPxQPF1J1vI8U8xdeemnS6ozhTPV20siaL_n4cCXp-mBVFv-Px-jCeU997FQZIroMbtxuQYKqVsZQWq4rbF91DIXd8Fcs50BUesDwQxP3TSBayWfaXyHu6h5wItNWUdfFPKOf2eulKHkXcnSeZoaWzNPxZ2-v93-dBfp-hDxaO-gaKHw8TX2_w_Ix4vGTCaBH5r2eLwIb-KPe8UeXSCfmxP9nCfKYGo6inGfXu6NSxfokEYfKxENXLdxpooCZMidk3HmfE3qM_b6)

As the father of two young girls, I’ve tried to instill in my daughters the same lessons that my parents taught me as a child: compassion, perseverance, and determination.

[](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=70e7fcaeacfe4414820e0394b921c71f&_e=mXtD0OlHSd-NBnGL2uWISWOjd_shL2SyEsuPOKCguByVosB50l8acnlvSEUAx39xM4k1ncUaksSEcJDgbuP8OWuxVTAo_oQxlHHt46joft5kRJ-Zm_VpFPxQPF1J1vI8U8xdeemnS6ozhTPV20siaL_n4cCXp-mBVFv-Px-jCeU997FQZIroMbtxuQYKqVsZQWq4rbF91DIXd8Fcs50BUesDwQxP3TSBayWfaXyHu6hjuaAx_V5wHkcXMwh7u0Og5TN1cOWisLt5MfaUY3JpPy1_ResubCRK16OGcn__OdipcOTwJ4aA9Bl8gtOVP_jfgA9BFIkCqrCPT9HNYTPveE7T8ClMbU_om-uDathRyYnH7cjrk-dOy-uEHVPZBm9R)

I take my role as a father very seriously, as do I take my commitment to Kentucky and to America. [**But Peter, what is happening in our country is beyond concerning - it goes against everything I believe in.**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=70e7fcaeacfe4414820e0394b921c71f&_e=mXtD0OlHSd-NBnGL2uWISWOjd_shL2SyEsuPOKCguByVosB50l8acnlvSEUAx39xM4k1ncUaksSEcJDgbuP8OWuxVTAo_oQxlHHt46joft5kRJ-Zm_VpFPxQPF1J1vI8U8xdeemnS6ozhTPV20siaL_n4cCXp-mBVFv-Px-jCeU997FQZIroMbtxuQYKqVsZQWq4rbF91DIXd8Fcs50BUesDwQxP3TSBayWfaXyHu6hPF8UiD0QXEw04w0cVU9xisLAKbC4q7AiiCfIgRNjK8ze8UnMDiriV0uUiB2AD7cqBIqPKNPu99-_I7zoMwW2-rJIK9m_3tVxxyreHgwngxHB4UKpiRkObu2B6-DX-6krD00aPZfWFNz9fnXH0JBJH)

Flipping states like Pennsylvania blue - and protecting must-win seats like ours here in Connecticut - is absolutely essential to building a working majority in the Senate. disclaimer_text: Paid For By Mark Kelly for Senate
body:
#

Hi Friends,
I’m coming to you personally with a heartfelt request: Will you join me in supporting Mark Kelly’s Senate campaign in Arizona?
I’ll explain why this race needs your attention, but if you’re ready to support Mark, [**please chip in $3 or whatever you can afford now.**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-sept22.nZ-xom&refcode=em220922-2-15&t=1&akid=3941%2E6688874%2ESzb6oh)
Mark Kelly is an essential voice in the Senate, one that we can’t afford to lose. He’s helped pass legislation to combat the climate crisis, lower prescription drug costs, tackle long overdue infrastructure projects – and he’s just getting started!
**The thing is, National Republicans have targeted Mark Kelly for defeat.**
Donald Trump even said at a rally that taking back America starts with “kicking Mark Kelly the hell out of the United States Senate.”
But it’s not just fiery rhetoric that we’re up against. Mark’s GOP opponent is funded by a billionaire benefactor who is spending millions of dollars to replace Senator Kelly with a Trump-endorsed, far-right candidate named Blake Masters.
**We cannot allow Senator Kelly’s extreme, far-right Republican opponent anywhere NEAR the Senate.**
Here are some of the things Masters has said he supports:
* A TOTAL ban on abortion.
* DESTRUCTION of the Social Security benefits so many seniors rely on.
* REPEAL of the Affordable Care Act, which would take health care away from millions.

It sure seems like cruelty is the point. If you agree, please donate whatever you can afford to help Mark Kelly lift people up.

****
Mark has served our country for years as Captain Mark Kelly. He continues to serve as Senator Mark Kelly. And he isn’t taking corporate PAC money. Instead, he’s counting on grassroots donors like you to help him overcome shady Super PAC spending.
I’m so proud to have you join me in helping Mark reach his fundraising goals.
[**Thank you for chipping in $3 or whatever you can afford to help re-elect Mark Kelly in Arizona.**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-sept22.nZ-xom&refcode=em220922-2-15&t=26&akid=3941%2E6688874%2ESzb6oh)

Please know that I wish you and your family all the best.
Carole

Peter —
First and foremost, I want to say thank you to everybody who has supported our grassroots campaign. I am so grateful to the more than 100,000 people who have helped us get to where we are - less than 2 months from making history. It is humbling.
The truth is I’m reaching out with a request today because we have an important FEC fundraising deadline at the end of this month. Will you please consider making a contribution to our grassroots campaign to help us hit our ambitious goal? Please use this link to give:
**[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pm-email-220921-cb](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51166678/368455136/1860293669?refcode=pm_em_220922_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDM4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyNDUyZmM0Yi1iNDNhLWVkMTEtYTI3Yy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=jQoRG51UDsIrClhXjMd9tQTjhN248xty3oU2lbkHzI8=)**
We’re heading into the final stretch of this campaign. Everything has already kicked into high gear. Senate Republicans’ outside spending is going to increase by millions of dollars.
Look, their super PACs can spend millions on false attack ads against me, like they’re doing right now. But I refuse to back down because this seat and North Carolina’s next Senator’s vote should not be for sale.
My opponent Ted Budd thinks he can just let special interests buy this seat for him, and in return, he’ll continue doing exactly what he’s done in Congress — voting to keep the system rigged in favor of billionaires and corporations. He will fight for a future where abortion is banned in every state, where marriage equality is overturned, and where economic inequality only gets worse.
I’m running this race to be a voice for people just like you. I will not accept a future where our children have fewer rights than we did. We cannot go backward. I will never hesitate to do what is right in the U.S. Senate — justice for the people will be my North Star.
But the truth is I simply cannot do this alone.
**[So I’m humbly asking you to split a $5 contribution to our campaign and Patty Murray today to help us flip this seat and expand our Senate majority. Our end-of-quarter FEC deadline is almost here, and it is critical that we reach our goal and raise the resources necessary to compete with the super PACs trying to buy this seat.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51166679/368455138/1860293669?refcode=pm_em_220922_1&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=18326&firstname=Peter&lastname=&addr1=&city=Cresco&state=PA&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDM4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyNDUyZmM0Yi1iNDNhLWVkMTEtYTI3Yy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=jQoRG51UDsIrClhXjMd9tQTjhN248xty3oU2lbkHzI8=)**

subject: A personal note about our new ad.
body:
Hi Peter,
I wanted to reach out personally to make sure you saw the news that we are up on the air with our [first positive TV ad](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51142772/368402632/-878742885?refcode=em-9.22.22-all-b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4N2JlZTQ5MC05NDNhLWVkMTEtYTI3Yy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=quoF0s-AweAOhkoV48J0Z28--b5HLcjYciG_F1yx5nA=) of the General Election.
I’m proud of how the ad turned out, and I must say, being behind the camera for the shoot sent me back to my days delivering the weather news. I was a bit rusty, but we nailed it in just a few takes. _It certainly wasn't as high stakes as shooting a live newscast!_
Launching this ad was also a huge reminder of just how powerful television can be -- not only because of its vast reach, but in the way it helps us connect with people. Some of the most enriching connections I've made have been with new friends and neighbors who saw one of my segments then ran into me at the grocery store or a restaurant. It's my hope that this ad has a similar effect in these final 47 days before the election.
**As you may know, we adjusted our budget to get this television ad on the air earlier than anticipated. That’s because the super PACs spending on behalf of our opponent are driving up the prices of TV time -- so we’re being as efficient as possible with your contributions. **
Friday is a big wiring deadline to send the stations funds to keep this ad on the air. We're hoping to raise another $20,000 before then, and your contribution of $5 would go a long way in meeting that mark.
If you can, please chip in today. Here is the link to donate: **[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/es-q3-2022?refcode=dpwillis67@gmail.com](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51142774/368402633/-295409223?refcode=em-9.22.22-all-b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4N2JlZTQ5MC05NDNhLWVkMTEtYTI3Yy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=quoF0s-AweAOhkoV48J0Z28--b5HLcjYciG_F1yx5nA=)**

body:
A few years ago, New York magazine posed the question: “When Did Everyone Become a Socialist?”
[View this message in your browser](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zs4bbrjvtahdlhkckono0qa3nasebksv5g41qp8o_rp22sh2s8i66or6c3jm6o71c5h238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq2d9ieuqfbdbie4rrcdljkorrbdt469r31d5jekrq9onicbrmbdbkmsprcs3j6spj0s75eaqred9kcpoj2sdj6jjr8thkm9hbep5ksmom9dhgsv970sj46oob4pjiegonco70mhij1o5l65iecpj664pb6p30e9r6cdj76mp6fc5lclp2bs)
| | This sponsored message from Deroy Murdock is on behalf of Hillsdale College | [](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z2h4bsncofbpf9ae7mfbhos2v0s98005kp24ktj0_rp22sh2s8i66or6c3jm6o71c5h2bs)
---
| |
Dear Fellow American, A few years ago, _New York_ magazine posed the question: “When Did Everyone Become a Socialist?” This is, of course, an exaggeration. But it makes clear that the far-Left in America aims to bring about a “Great Reset” of our economy and our way of life. In a recent issue of _Imprimis_ —Hillsdale College’s digest of liberty—author Michael Rectenwald described the economic goal of the Great Reset as “‘capitalism with Chinese characteristics’—a two-tiered economy, with profitable monopolies and the state on top and socialism for the majority below.” Today, as a supporter of liberty, you can help Hillsdale College understand the extent of support for—and opposition to—socialism. Your input will help us develop the most effective strategy to fight for the future of liberty in our country. **Will you please share your views on the political, social, and cultural forces promoting socialism in our country by completing your National Survey on Socialism using the secure link below?** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zlhnaesp7gqu4t7jo3lsi7kl4nkble5qqtvgltko_rp22sh2s8i66or6c3jm6o71c5h2bs)** Sadly, socialism is becoming increasingly popular, especially among the young. You may be aware of a SHOCKING survey showing that... **. . . during the COVID-19 pandemic, support for socialism among those 16 to 23 years old jumped to 49 percent, and socialism also increased in popularity among all ages.** **Why is this?** Draconian government lockdown measures destroyed businesses and eliminated competitors of corporate monopolists. These policies were a dream come true for corporate socialists. At the same time, too many young Americans have not been taught what socialism really means. Or the dismal history of its failures wherever it has been tried. This is a result of the far-Left’s “long march through the institutions”—including colleges and universities, K-12 schools, and the media. Marxist-inspired critical race theory is a prime example. Once confined to the classrooms of far-Left professors, critical race theory has infiltrated every level of government, as well as school boards and even the military. But it is in our schools where the effects of critical race theory—which teaches young Americans to categorize their fellow citizens according to race—are most dangerous. You may recall that many young Americans with college degrees who championed socialist policies participated in the riots and violence we witnessed in the summer of 2020. In the face of well-financed and widespread efforts to destroy free markets and individual liberty, Hillsdale’s work to **reach** and **teach** millions has never been more urgently needed. **That’s why I need your thoughts quickly.** By responding to the **National Survey on Socialism** in the next five days**,** your honest opinions will help us understand the recent rise of socialism and develop our strategy to **reach** and **teach** increasing millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. We hope to hear from friends representing every part of the country. Education is the surest way to turn back this dangerous trend. And your partnership with Hillsdale College is critical. As Winston Churchill said, “Socialism is the philosophy of failure, the creed of ignorance, and the gospel of envy.” If you agree, please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Socialism** today. **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z2gaahn8th1a7rc7ded00o6jhg32r8raa37oqi60_rp22sh2s8i66or6c3jm6o71c5h2bs)** Despite the recent successes of the far-Left, we must remember—**it is NEVER too late to defend liberty through education**. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
---

name: Tom Fitton
subject: I Think I Know Why…
body:
You have an enormous stake in helping protect the honesty and integrity of American elections...the linchpin of our Republic.

| |
---
|
---
|
---
| Dear Fellow American,

You have an enormous stake in helping protect the honesty and integrity of American elections...the linchpin of our Republic.
Yet, _you weren't one of the thousands_ of Americans who answered my previous emails about our many successes forcing states to combat voter fraud...
**_I think I know why_.**
_I suspect you haven 't answered my emails asking for your support because you_ _doubted_ that your help and our hard work could really make a difference and protect honest elections; or you mistakenly _thought_ that **Judicial Watch** gets the money we need to successfully investigate and prosecute corrupt politicians from legal fees.
If I'm right, it means you want proof that **Judicial Watch** truly does _make a di_ _fference_ , and that we truly do _need your support_ to continue to produce important results...
Most people do not know that **Judicial Watch** _depends almost ENTIRELY on individual grassroots support and does not charge its clients legal fees_.
And most people do not know _we 've had great success fighting to protect the honesty of our elections, forcing states to clean their voter rolls to combat voter fraud and defending state voter ID laws_.
That's why I am reaching out to you again...to answer your questions and explain why your tax-deductible contribution today has never been as important...
[And to encourage you to join **Judicial Watch 's** army of supporters](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60348&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE) - an extraordinary group of citizens whose support is absolutely vital to our success fighting _for_ the rule of law and transparency in government and _against_ public corruption.
| [Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60348&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE)
---

I am going this extra mile because _I believe keeping our elections honest is how we can guarantee the survival of our Republic ...and **Judicial Watch** is the "only game in town" blocking the Left's drive to open the door to wholesale corruption of our elections_.

You see, a while back we found one key problem with our electoral system that goes back years. It's about poor voter registration list maintenance practices that create "dirty lists" that can undermine the integrity of our elections.

"Dirty" or inaccurate voter registration rolls that contain the names of folks who have died or moved away are an open invitation to voter fraud - especially in the absence of voter ID requirements. Dirty voting rolls make it easier for ineligible voters...like non-U.S. citizens and dead voters...to cast ballots.

Yet many states...red states, blue states, and purple states ...fail to fulfill the list maintenance obligations of the 1993 **National Voter Registration Act (NVRA).**

Beginning in 2012, **Judicial Watch 's** has become the national leader in forcing states to address these issues and clean up their voter rolls as federal law requires!

* We threatened legal action in **Florida** , which led to state election officials removing over 50,000 deceased voters from the rolls.
* Warning letters issued by **Judicial Watch** to **Maryland** and **West****Virginia** led those two states to begin cleaning their voter rolls.
* Our lawsuit against **Indiana** led to a statewide clean-up of voter lists.
* We reached a settlement with **Ohio** in which the state agreed to undertake voter list maintenance and other actions to protect against voter fraud.
* A **Judicial Watch** lawsuit led to a consent decree issued by a federal judge to which **Kentucky** and the U.S. Justice Department were parties to clean its voter rolls.

And our federal lawsuit against **California** and its **Los Angeles County** led to a legal settlement wherein the county agreed to _purge 1.6 million ineligible voters from its registration rolls_.

This was a huge success and we are now in the middle of major lawsuits in **Colorado, New York** and **Pennsylvania** to force those states to follow the law on voter list maintenance.

And earlier this year, in another _major victory for honest elections and for Judicial_ _Watch_ , we settled our federal lawsuit against **North Carolina** _after they removed over_ _430,000 ineligible names from their voter rolls_ ... _a 36% drop in inactive registrations_!

But the Left is pushing on all fronts to corrupt our elections, destroy longstanding ballot integrity safeguards and make it easier for non-citizens to vote.

**Why else would they oppose accurate voter rolls?**

So the critical court battles for clean voter rolls and honest election continue...

And who is the one organization fighting against the combined forces of the Biden Justice Department, the Soros network and radical Left politicians?

**Judicial Watch.**

While others complain...which is _easy_ to do...**Judicial Watch** is doing the _hard_ work of digging into the job of researching, investigating and litigating to get _results_!

And I believe that if you will join with us today, we will be able to keep winning critically important victories in this epic battle to preserve honest elections in America.

**That is why I hope you will support our continuing investigations and litigation _[by making a special tax-deductible contribution](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60348&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE)_.**

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60348&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE)
---

If we do not persist in this battle... _who will_?

_Certainly not the Biden Justice Department,_ where left-leaning bureaucrats are itching to dictate election policies to the states.

_Certainly not the mainstream media_ , which engages in daily distortions of conservative election reform measures, parrots the false rhetoric of the Biden administration and Soros network - and engages in daily deception and distortion.

_And certainly not Congress_ , where serious oversight of election law enforcement is not a priority.

**Judicial Watch** has been the scourge of corrupt and unlawfully secretive politicians since 1994...we truly are the "only game in town" when it comes to fighting for honest elections.

**_And your support is vital to Judicial Watch 's ability to deliver the legal investigations, litigation and public education you deserve_.**

So if you do indeed value our efforts to _uphold_ the rule of law, _fight_ for the U.S. Constitution and honest elections, and _hold_ lawless politicians (Democrats _and_ Republicans) and politically biased bureaucrats _accountable_ , [I hope you will give us your personal support.](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60348&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE)

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60348&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE)
---

_Thank you for making your best possible donation today_. And thank you for joining with us in our mission of exposing public corruption, upholding the rule of law and fighting for the American people's right to know!

Sincerely,

Tom Fitton
President

Hello everyone,
My husband Michael and I had the privilege of serving our nation together for almost three decades.
Different schools, new doctors, different commute, pack up and unpack, good-byes to old friends and hellos to new neighbors — we moved from state-to-state and overseas. I didn’t know married life to a naval officer would be so busy or so enriching when we married in 1989. (Yes, I would do it over again!)
As a family, we were better for it. Our children saw many new schools, sometimes as many as three in a single year, and they were accepting of those disruptions to their lives. Deployments were made more tolerable when email came along, but Michael’s absence was always felt around the dinner table, on holidays, and during family events.
**No challenge we faced these last three decades, though, compares to the demands of running for the U.S. Senate.** Yet this is exactly why my husband is undertaking this next level of service — because he has consistently made the impossible look doable and the difficult look commonplace. If anyone can beat Chuck Grassley, he can do it. My sense is that the nation needs people like him.
Admiral Michael Franken, my hubby, is the right person to be Iowa’s next Senator. I believe in him, and I know he will wow you, as well. His soul is Iowa’s. **But if Mike is going to win, turn Iowa blue, and fix the many challenges Iowa, its citizens, and this nation face, he needs your help today.**

Hello everyone, My husband Michael and I had the privilege of serving our nation together for almost three decades. Our children saw many new schools, sometimes as many as three in a single year, and they were accepting of those disruptions to their lives. body:
If we’re going to make a difference in this race, now is the time to get involved.
#

Good morning.
I’m about to ask you to split a $5 donation between my campaign and Cheri Beasley’s campaign for Senate in North Carolina. Here’s why I’m asking, particularly today:
North Carolina is likely to be one of the closest Senate races in the country, and with a 50/50 margin right now, if we can flip North Carolina, we have a good shot at keeping control of the Senate — _and even expanding our majority._
The problem is, Mitch McConnell and Donald Trump also know how important North Carolina is. That’s why McConnell’s Super PAC has bought $28 MILLION worth of ads for the final two months, and it’s why Donald Trump is holding a rally there tomorrow.
But that’s not all — Marjorie Taylor Greene and Lauren Boebert also announced that they will be in North Carolina this weekend trying to fire up the far-right base.
**They’re doing everything they can to drown out Cheri’s campaign because they know she can win this race. So I’m asking for your support to help her rise above the noise:**
[**Can you please split a $5 contribution between our campaign and Cheri Beasley’s to ensure they have the resources to respond to the attacks coming their way and FLIP North Carolina blue?**](https://act.alex-padilla.com/go/553?c0=ap-em-sep22-cb.ndSa6S&refcode=em220922-1-60&t=1&akid=1009%2E159979%2Eb542Ga)
Cheri’s running a strong campaign — organizing and reaching folks in ALL of North Carolina’s 100 counties.
But running a campaign all across a state like North Carolina is expensive. And when you’re running a grassroots campaign like Cheri, that means it also requires a significant amount of grassroots support.
People are already casting the very first vote-by-mail ballots in North Carolina, and in-person early voting starts soon. **So if we’re going to make a difference in this race,_now_ is the time to get involved.**
[**Please, split a donation between our campaign and Cheri Beasley before Trump’s rally tomorrow. Let’s all do our part to flip this seat and hold the Senate for Democrats.**](https://act.alex-padilla.com/go/553?c0=ap-em-sep22-cb.ndSa6S&refcode=em220922-1-60&t=2&akid=1009%2E159979%2Eb542Ga)
Thank you for anything you can afford to give, and have a great rest of your day!
Alex Padilla

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. I just delivered an important speech in New Hampshire about the future of our country and of the Republican Party.

I gave the speech because a few weeks ago, the President of the United States recently smeared half the country as enemies of the state. He essentially said if you're pro-life or you oppose his policies, you're a threat.

I traveled to New Hampshire because I'm not going to let that just slide by. I'm going to stand up for the Americans that the President attacked. Because America deserves better than that.

See, Ronald Reagan reminded us, _" Freedom is never more than one generation away from extinction. It has to be fought for and defended by each generation._"

Today, the frontline of the fight for freedom at home is the fight against woke ideology.

_**Wokeism is fracturing**_. It teaches our children that what divides us is more significant than what unites us.

_**Wokeism is coercive.**_ It demands that we censor ourselves or be canceled.

_**Wokeism is hopeless.**_ It teaches our children that identity, rather than character, is destiny; Using race and gender to divide.

And Joe Biden is injecting wokeism into the worst places: our schools and our military.

Our children are our future, and our troops are our vanguard against hostile nations that wish to do us harm. If they are corrupted by the scourge of wokeism, hope is forfeit.

If we are going to save the America we know and love, **we must put wokeism to sleep.**

As we near the end of this month, I’d like to call attention to the stakes of this election.
Let me be clear — we have a governor who has used his office to make life more difficult for Tennesseans. Whether it’s the current state law that makes reproductive freedom challenging, his refusal to expand Medicaid to assist up to 400,000 Tennesseans, or general antagonism to LGBTQ+ youth, it is clear that Bill Lee is more concerned with staying in power than helping the people of his state.
I’m running for governor to be a voice for every Tennessean — that’s what the role of governor should be. We have a choice this November to allow Bill Lee to carry out his disastrous policies for four more years or to elect a governor who will fight for the people.

**Friend — It’s no secret that abortion rights are on the ballot this November.** But what may _not_ be so obvious is the fact that just a small number of seats in each state could “represent the tipping point,” as _Politico_ put it in a recent article: | [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/51154429/368425416/1479146301?&amount=20&refcode=20220922.2r_527&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjgzZDBjNDVjLWEwM2EtZWQxMS1hMjdjLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=FTd3f8X7IpWPtdgv29ifyEb0UdfMSNGGTRdf9-PWfgI=)

That’s why the NDRC has been hard at work investing in down-ballot races all over the country that will determine the future of abortion rights, LGBTQ rights, and our democracy itself. Here’s what we’re doing in the run-up to Election Day:
➞ **Working in 17 target states** to protect access to the ballot and stop extremist GOP candidates who want to roll back our rights
➞ **Supporting 313 Democracy Defenders** up and down the ballot who will do everything in their power to defend our rights
➞ **Thwarting GOP efforts to corrupt the pool of election workers and cause chaos at the polls**
This model has led us to **tremendous success** in the past: In the 2020 redistricting cycle, it helped produce some of the fairest maps in a generation. So with the stakes of this year’s midterms higher than ever before in our lifetimes, it’s critical that we double down on our work.

body:
I decided to run for the U.S. Senate in 2010 because growing entitlements and out-of-control federal spending had exploded our national debt to $14 trillion.
|
---
| | | Peter,

I decided to run for the U.S. Senate in 2010 because growing entitlements and out-of-control federal spending had exploded our national debt to $14 trillion. We were on an unsustainable path that was mortgaging our children's future.

Fortunately, Americans decided that a government controlled by liberal Democrats wasn't good for the country, and they elected Republicans to the House to halt President Obama's extreme policies. A Republican majority in the Senate followed in 2014.

As I ran for re-election in 2016, we had the prospect of electing a Republican president who could work with a Republican Congress not only to stop the expansion of liberal policies but, we hoped, to reverse some of the damage done during Mr. Obama's administration. I figured we had an opportunity to put America back on the right path, and I was more than willing to dedicate myself to that worthy effort.

By and large, Republican policies worked. Regulatory relief and a more competitive tax system helped create a healthy economy with low inflation and record low unemployment. Strengthening the military deterred our enemies, and policies designed to secure the borders dramatically reduced the flow of illegal immigration.

During the 2016 campaign, I said it would be my last campaign and final term. That was my strong preference, and my wife's--we both looked forward to a normal private life. However, neither of us anticipated the Democrats' complete takeover of government and the disastrous policies they have already inflicted on America and the world, to say nothing of those they threaten to enact in the future.

Nor did we anticipate the pandemic, the government's failed response to it, the loss of freedom that has resulted, and the tyrannical approach taken by the elites who have created and maintained a state of fear that allows them to exercise control over Americans' lives. Instead of everyone working to achieve the goal President Biden stated during his inaugural address--unifying and healing America--it feels as if our nation is being torn apart.

As I travel around Wisconsin and talk to citizens who love our country, I know I am not the only one with grave concerns. My message has always been that America is precious, and it is our solemn duty to make sure it survives and thrives for future generations.

President Reagan warned that freedom is fragile, always one generation away from extinction. As I have told crowds since my first Tea Party speeches in 2010: This is a fight for freedom. This is not someone else's fight, this is our fight, and it's a fight we absolutely must win.

I believe America is in peril. Much as I'd like to ease into a quiet retirement, I don't feel I should. Countless people have encouraged me to run, saying they rely on me to be their voice, to speak plain and obvious truths other elected leaders shirk from expressing--truths the elite in government, mainstream media, and Big Tech don't want you to hear.

In 2010 I promised I would always tell people the truth and that I would never vote with re-election in mind. When re-election isn't your primary motivation, those are easy promises to keep. Today, I am announcing I will continue to fight for freedom in the public realm by running for re-election. It is a decision I haven't made lightly. Having already experienced a growing level of vitriol and false attacks, I certainly don't expect better treatment in the future. For my campaign to succeed, I will need the support of every American who values the truth and refuses to allow lies and distortions to prevail.

Tens of millions of dollars will be spent trying to destroy and defeat me. The mainstream media and Big Tech will contribute their powerful and corrupt voices as the unofficial but reliable communication apparatus of the Democrats. We face powerful forces that desire even more power and control over our lives. Their path, paved with false hope and greater dependency, always leads to tyranny. We cannot let them win.

So I will humbly ask for your endorsement to help me SAVE AMERICA.

Regulatory relief and a more competitive tax system helped create a healthy economy with low inflation and record low unemployment. Strengthening the military deterred our enemies, and policies designed to secure the borders dramatically reduced the flow of illegal immigration. During the 2016 campaign, I said it would be my last campaign and final term. That was my strong preference, and my wife's--we both looked forward to a normal private life. However, neither of us anticipated the Democrats' complete takeover of government and the disastrous policies they have already inflicted on America and the world, to say nothing of those they threaten to enact in the future. Nor did we anticipate the pandemic, the government's failed response to it, the loss of freedom that has resulted, and the tyrannical approach taken by the elites who have created and maintained a state of fear that allows them to exercise control over Americans' lives. Instead of everyone working to achieve the goal President Biden stated during his inaugural address--unifying and healing America--it feels as if our nation is being torn apart. As I travel around Wisconsin and talk to citizens who love our country, I know I am not the only one with grave concerns. My message has always been that America is precious, and it is our solemn duty to make sure it survives and thrives for future generations. President Reagan warned that freedom is fragile, always one generation away from extinction. As I have told crowds since my first Tea Party speeches in 2010: This is a fight for freedom. This is not someone else's fight, this is our fight, and it's a fight we absolutely must win. I believe America is in peril. Much as I'd like to ease into a quiet retirement, I don't feel I should. Countless people have encouraged me to run, saying they rely on me to be their voice, to speak plain and obvious truths other elected leaders shirk from expressing--truths the elite in government, mainstream media, and Big Tech don't want you to hear. In 2010 I promised I would always tell people the truth and that I would never vote with re-election in mind. When re-election isn't your primary motivation, those are easy promises to keep. Today, I am announcing I will continue to fight for freedom in the public realm by running for re-election. It is a decision I haven't made lightly. Having already experienced a growing level of vitriol and false attacks, I certainly don't expect better treatment in the future. For my campaign to succeed, I will need the support of every American who values the truth and refuses to allow lies and distortions to prevail. Tens of millions of dollars will be spent trying to destroy and defeat me. The mainstream media and Big Tech will contribute their powerful and corrupt voices as the unofficial but reliable communication apparatus of the Democrats. We face powerful forces that desire even more power and control over our lives. Their path, paved with false hope and greater dependency, always leads to tyranny. We cannot let them win. If you listened to President Biden’s bizarre speech earlier this month, you heard a message meant to scare and divide the public. Like you, we watched the speech wondering: **What ever happened to the “uniter” that Biden tried to portray himself as in the 2020 campaign?**

**The answer is simple:** the “uniter” never existed. By labeling everyday Americans as “extremists," he and the hard left showed their true colors.

Biden doesn’t understand what Make America Great Again (**MAGA**) means to folks like you and me. To us, it stands for timeless principles like limited government, more freedom, personal responsibility, and a strong and secure country.

Biden and Pelosi view Americans who share these conservative beliefs as “**deplorable** ”. They want to destroy each of President Trump’s accomplishments, and in just 2 years, their policies have taken us...

* from a safe, secure border to no border at all
* from safe neighborhoods to record crime

But we're still in the fight of our lives today with the forces of fanaticism and authoritarianism, and this is a fight taking place across America. The struggle to defend the right to vote and democratic elections begins at the state and local level. That’s why it’s critically important to elect Democratic state legislators. **I know the central importance of that role, I served as a state Senator in Maryland’s General Assembly for ten years.** **When I was a state legislator, I learned that you can be a justice politician or an injustice politician.** GOP legislators have chosen the injustice path – one that prioritizes voter suppression, dangerous abortion bans, and backward-looking anti-LGBTQ+ policies. I know that by coming together to build Democratic power in the states this fall, we can build a future that puts the needs of the American people ahead of the Trumpified Republicans’ lust for power. **But state legislative races are consistently underfunded and overlooked. So I’m reaching out to you right now on behalf of my friends at the Democratic Legislative Campaign Committee to ask for your help electing state Democrats across America. Whether we are talking about voting rights, redistricting or the rights of women, state legislatures are essential to the success of democracy and freedom in America.** [Will you send in a gift of $7 right now to support pro-democracy state Democrats this November and beyond? I want to bring my skills as a fighter, a litigator, and a negotiator to the halls of government. As lieutenant governor, I want to champion women’s rights, make sure our kids have access to the best education possible, and provide high-quality health care to everyone, especially our veterans.

Under McMaster, our state isn’t living up to its full potential. We have leaders who are rejecting lifesaving Medicaid funds just to score political points, taking away women’s freedom to do what they want with their own bodies, and leaving our children behind in their schooling.

subject: about my decision to run for Senate
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Rosen for Nevada
body:
I'm proud that my faith tradition helps guide my service to Nevada and our country.
| | |
---
Friend,

Want to know how I first got into politics? I was recruited to run for Congress while serving as the president of my synagogue.

Looking back, although it seems a bit unconventional, it's incredibly fitting that leading Nevada’s largest synagogue was my entry point to public service. My Jewish faith and values are at the very core of so much of my work in the Senate today. In fact, my decision to run for public office in the first place was guided by the Jewish principle of Tikkun Olam – which means to leave the world a better place than how we found it.
**Now, as both the third Jewish woman senator in U.S. history and the only former synagogue president in the Senate, I'm proud that my faith tradition helps guide my service to Nevada and our country.**

I firmly believe that if everybody stands firm and does their part to help better this world, we can move mountains to make positive change happen. **As we face everything from growing antisemitism to attacks on abortion rights and threats to tear down our very democracy, there's never been a more crucial time for us to come together, roll up our sleeves, and make a difference.**
**[So if the principle of Tikkun Olam resonates with you – if you're with me in the fight to make real progress for our country – I hope you'll chip in $5 or more today to help me continue this critical work in the Senate.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51171603/368474195/610767770?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk2031-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjNjkzMjE2Mi1jNTNhLWVkMTEtYTI3Yy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=aQYOvHMEbhjwy96zKuWGdqvwM6CIK4LfqUrheZro1M0=)**

Sign on today to stand up against antisemitism and hate.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51172072/368475849/-849735382?refcode=EM_PET_220922KIF_Achievements_PETITION_ALL_4_NG_TESTA_logo&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzg0NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4YWU2ODg0YS1jNjNhLWVkMTEtYTI3Yy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=npnBSXJNQP3kMMoZsXY4jFFn99Gr8oCfDZzC_X374EQ=) We’ve got exciting news, Peter.

Congresswoman Shontel Brown’s first stand-alone bill has passed the House and is poised to pass the Senate with the help of Senator Sherrod Brown any day now.

Designating Bedford Heights’ own Kol Israel Foundation Holocaust Memorial as a national memorial in Ohio’s 11th Congressional District, this critical bipartisan bill ensures that the Kol Israel Holocaust Memorial receives the recognition it deserves as likely the oldest of its kind in the United States.

For six decades, the Kol Israel Foundation Holocaust Memorial has educated Ohioans about the horrors of the Holocaust and honors the memories of those lost to this evil. Its dedication as a national memorial is a recommitment to our fight against hate and injustice wherever it may stand.

We have a huge opportunity to unseat a powerful Republican incumbent and give New York the leadership it deserves. Will you join me in supporting my friend Matt Castelli with a $5 donation. He has a real shot at flipping this district blue, with your support >>>

No one thought I had a chance of defeating them — but we dug deep, rallied together, outworked our opponent, and made the impossible possible.
I know Matt can do the same, but he needs our help to get it done.

Election experts are calling our race a "toss-up," which is why Kevin McCarthy and D.C Republicans are flooding our district with nearly $7 million in attack ads. We set an ambitious goal to raise $125,000 online before our end-of-quarter deadline to help us fight back against these attacks. But if we come up short, we might need to look at making budget cuts. This is one of the most expensive House races in the whole country. Not reaching our goal would mean we won't be able to reach every voter we can on TV, in the field, by mail, and online, and risk getting drowned out by Republican attacks. Peter, As the crisis at our southern border worsens, the Left seems to be up in arms and offended about everything _**except the crisis itself.**_

I haven't heard a peep about the millions of people who are being told by Biden they can just walk freely into our country. I haven’t heard a peep about these people being used and abused by the cartels.

There’s been no outrage over immigrants drowning in the Rio Grande. No outcries about the 50 immigrants found dead in the back of a truck in Texas.

_**I’ve heard no outrage about any of that.**_

The reality is, Friend, illegal immigrants are crossing the border and being left on the streets in border towns. _**[Reject Biden’s open border policy>>>](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=9a98777a3e9f41eaa3be121f5f1adbe7&_e=Ns9ASspIThVbfhYJKGY4hOpczEOPZTXrJUwX2qJRNhYZIQ2x0fdTPaOrftcKQ2yKIic9OXbs8oSJQTxAsDfQEnfK-mUxYkxykcc1iEmujKOi5jrQu8uhPgNcMyxbrO9wI_kCqCauBIzBYDwOk9IOw6F9VePWCDiMt79SeFG5WBduA5IB5EZfVPupaMrh2VDXCVFJxZtIFhX7zSL8V4iDKsncRh2t6f2qHbtShFszZLZUSARnPX19y5t-YwADAMdN2iPLwuD7qiazmes1ojW5vnyVv_sgnch_FUAQg06R8Mb32cHOvsl9KSK39v2cpMfzdahbdT3Cd3lfKs-xB9vSTvHSHoK3ERt0sZla32ZDIqk%3D "Reject Biden’s open border policy>>>")**_ Biden and the virtue signaling Left don’t care about the safety of migrants illegally entering our country, and they don’t care about the safety of Floridians and the communities across America being destroyed by the traffickers, smugglers, and dangerous drugs freely flowing into our country.

_**The regime isn’t doing anything to solve the crisis at the border because this isn’t a crisis Biden inherited, it’s a crisis Biden created.**_

Joe, the woke Left, and their corporate press lapdogs are strategically ignoring that the problem at our border exists.

Failed Border Czar Kamala Harris is dealing with the crisis by simply declaring the border is secure, claiming there is no crisis. Biden is asserting that there are actually fewer migrants coming in through our southern border.

The reality is, the border is more open than ever before under Biden’s watch and we’ve had more illegal crossings take place under his administration than any other time in our nation’s history.

_**This is not a situation where Biden tried his best and it just didn’t work. This was an intentional action Biden took to reverse policies that were effective.**_

The Left has been chirping about political stunts to deflect from the real issues happening at the border, but the biggest political stunt by far has been Biden coming in as president and reversing policies that worked just to virtue signal to his base. _**[Fight back>>>](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=9a98777a3e9f41eaa3be121f5f1adbe7&_e=Ns9ASspIThVbfhYJKGY4hOpczEOPZTXrJUwX2qJRNhYZIQ2x0fdTPaOrftcKQ2yKIic9OXbs8oSJQTxAsDfQEnfK-mUxYkxykcc1iEmujKOi5jrQu8uhPgNcMyxbrO9wI_kCqCauBIzBYDwOk9IOw6F9VePWCDiMt79SeFG5WBduA5IB5EZfVPupaMrh2VDXCVFJxZtIFhX7zSL8V4iDKjqDEkQFiv73BmaOtM9gV2Em_6T6C3bcS1d31kh9Uxo9QIInnC2Xjbsts0GHv7LpDkzWNUNC54HcsuhBvU4s36967vZNaajxUNoaO5m4eywj282o7o2dcVAIcOnXCRf_c09yKHq5KOE9iUIUKV2D6Vs%3D "Fight back>>>")**_

Joe was willing to risk the security of our nation and the safety of our communities to gain brownie points with his extremist base.

The impact of Biden’s border crisis has left our communities ravaged by destruction and despair. The sheer volume of the cartel’s dangerous drugs being brought in at such a rapid pace, it’s nearly impossible for local communities to tackle.

Biden’s refusal to take any action is devastating American communities across the United States with fentanyl now the number one cause of death for Americans between the ages of 18-45.

Americans are being victimized by criminal aliens illegally crossing the border.

_**These crimes are especially hard to stomach because if Biden would’ve just done his job, the crime would have never happened.**_

The fact of the matter is, Friend, the false outrage from the Left has nothing to do with humanity or decency – it has to do with Democrats’ seemingly inherent need to posture themselves as morally superior. _**[Hold the Left accountable>>>](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=9a98777a3e9f41eaa3be121f5f1adbe7&_e=Ns9ASspIThVbfhYJKGY4hOpczEOPZTXrJUwX2qJRNhYZIQ2x0fdTPaOrftcKQ2yKIic9OXbs8oSJQTxAsDfQEnfK-mUxYkxykcc1iEmujKOi5jrQu8uhPgNcMyxbrO9wI_kCqCauBIzBYDwOk9IOw6F9VePWCDiMt79SeFG5WBduA5IB5EZfVPupaMrh2VDXCVFJxZtIFhX7zSL8V4iDKg_fbyP7rKL-DGFyklTog67by48DCGKjgarDWgTTn6jJB4sbqdUPNaXH-AxIcoexj03VVmaFpxw-9O3Eh79JcvXYx5f4vz5ye-6ekLHyqHMXgDjyNV0ikyAWm5rpOG1TawBkplfHZX3wvBSkx9vtVfU%3D "Hold the Left accountable>>>")**_

There is a simple answer to our problem: **secure the border.**

We need leaders with integrity who are willing to put the American people above their political standings. Biden and his pocket puppets, like my opponent, wouldn’t know the meaning of integrity if it were printed on a rubber wristband or written in 78-point font on a teleprompter.

_**I’m working hard to keep the Left’s extremism out of Florida, but I need your help to stop them.**_

My mission to Keep Florida Free will require the help of every supporter. We cannot afford to sit on the sidelines as our country slips further into chaos and destruction.

body:
FLASHBACK: June 2018’s big upset.
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20220922-3415-header&t=1&akid=3415%2E2526796%2E82VJ7h)
Remember this?
Way back in June of 2018, Alexandria and our grassroots movement shocked the nation in an upset that very few people saw coming.
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220922-mu.8F-Gy2&refcode=em20220922-3415-P_FND_EGR_GFM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=3415%2E2526796%2E82VJ7h)
Then in 2020, we proved that Alexandria’s victory wasn’t a fluke after she won her general, beating her Republican opponent who spent $10 million to unseat her.
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220922-mu.8F-Gy2&refcode=em20220922-3415-P_FND_EGR_GFM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=3415%2E2526796%2E82VJ7h)
Now it’s 2022, and Alexandria is up for re-election again this November – and how things shake out this year will depend greatly on you.
From day one, we have been defined by people-power and this year will be no different. In 2018, we beat a machine with a movement. In 2020, we beat millions in corporate and special interest dollars with that same movement. And we’re going to do it again. How? By once again proving that people-power is winning power.
[Our people-powered campaign was built by and is sustained by small-dollar donations from supporters like you giving to emails like these. Can you chip in $3 right now to help us prepare for November’s election and keep Alexandria’s courageous and progressive leadership in Congress?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220922-mu.8F-Gy2&refcode=em20220922-3415-P_FND_EGR_GFM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=3415%2E2526796%2E82VJ7h)
**[Contribute $3](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220922-mu.8F-Gy2&refcode=em20220922-3415-P_FND_EGR_GFM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=23&akid=3415%2E2526796%2E82VJ7h)**
Across the country, people look towards our campaign as a vanguard of progressive change. Every person who supports Alexandria’s reelection isn’t just supporting her — they’re supporting our movement and everything we’re fighting for.
That has an impact. When other members of Congress or politicians see thousands of grassroots activists aligning themselves in support of Medicare for All, a Green New Deal, and a livable minimum wage, it entices them to join our cause.
But building a movement takes work. **And Alexandria is facing off with a MAGA Republican opponent in the general election this November.**
[That’s why we’re asking for you to chip in whatever you can afford today to keep powering our growing movement and keep Alexandria in Congress — can we count on your donation now?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220922-mu.8F-Gy2&refcode=em20220922-3415-P_FND_EGR_GFM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=24&akid=3415%2E2526796%2E82VJ7h)
Everything we’ve accomplished so far, from Alexandria’s shock upset in 2018 to this very moment, is a credit to the grassroots movement we’ve built together. Thank you for being part of it.
In solidarity,
Team AOC

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20220922-mu?refcode=em20220922-3415-P_FND_EGR_GFM&t=25&refcode2=3415_2526796_82VJ7h&akid=3415%2E2526796%2E82VJ7h)** | **[Merch](https://shop.ocasiocortez.com/?utm_source=em-footer-20220922-3415-P_FND_EGR_GFM&t=26&akid=3415%2E2526796%2E82VJ7h)**

### Manchin finally announced his pipeline bill text yesterday, and we will not stand for it.
---
Senator Joe Manchin released the text of the “[Energy Independence and Security Act of 2022](https://url1005.email.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/atcYNHk4Eh2YdGnwBh-YDOSK1jTs-slTPJNStXBfxa3ZiTObbDcaKEnk-M3kMVmiRKBYYG4d8dDT_QP3yHMWEo4UoqklpQc1XA51KfGm0SkE2EAMjE_Dp3xIFL1Jf-N3kURjIhrQkouG7exwd2VoQJALDgbgxJEle0tBI02GZN2M-HMAo7m_PXSijebXZ0c9Kc5aM5saCiCmthaqwPnOhj5FKTNrXQJilf4nxoqGpEScGnxYW6-tLcBMWzI5dbbOo1Vl586ZFgCWzSilc1V1-8BXuL0LT7Ls66N_KjhEHQ1LNkqZShVbdmGF-anZHcuJPf71qpseAIqsl5gJWockdUc_mCBCuOq6MoliiEVfmNNkcn-pVi8yqj4wb2m0XaHG/3po/kFr3Z9ZyRnGWwulZJhz5NA/h1/lLSnadjnXqOX-7omSdBF3Ws8PTLU0AfSfbiGP3KH_mY)”, a backdoor attempt to gut environmental regulations and fast track his pet project, the Mountain Valley Pipeline (MVP). He struck a deal with Top Democrats to solicit their support for this fossil fuel wishlist in exchange for his vote to pass the Inflation Reduction Act. The bill attempts to dismantle bedrock environmental laws, evade environmental review and public input on energy projects, as well as limit community access to the courts for redress. Manchin’s bill requires the completion and operation of the MVP, regardless of delays and obstacles, and eliminates further judicial review of the project. What’s even more disturbing is that these same Top Dems have rolled the bill into must-pass legislation known as the Continuing Resolution (CR), which lawmakers will vote on next Friday, Sept 30th to keep the government funded.
###
The good news is: we’re up to [1/3 of U.S. House Democrats](https://url1005.email.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/mRNLFKyANPYkYXuUTzk_S2wrlc2yrpCv_XU04akvdeNiItZzXWQ28KZpYyvw4J0VrwXvIhfxK_dACjGBc5vkqfRNl2wrIFpzdtoGJrSd5lKn69XgfKQDclm6fOpdY3eVF3GFhi2LubJvfoqg8jhTeUq51S9BZ0Fug_A1wFLrA0rbAboHB39i9tlpYP5qJia70Bsnc_EfEvDSOjfTPtMqbl9V3W2bd6una0-rwVtcaODkLyENk1no0GbH4lV2LaWX-yFBoUGhhE1YPLxzqqS-VxkHLtCkvh5CkMdOYvTTKkLZugjLZajfEsEEC9ACIZaKt15akNooOOoLafHjBkj5Z5XHBZTXKfT2FlyPlCUedpCjszip-nhPmhktl5hLu1oqS3VVAzk1hKmXqYNR6cMI-oQqciubcjZwcQGQ1tOyq1cQ-mBoWxKmQgQPH9cGFM2IZFQVGuy84g--KoldAYMWPWN_r-kbgrBSANVWDOuH9tU2cGyR1T3eahaTunbl2OdpUjkEjcHo7ZBeXnGszo5YTsZD3ZLn8JKbdoq3eK7foreJuD4w8HTfMWwKTp_sT9sM4or1MxCrfr6UlipqinzmMhHxycNlj028OT2CwUpBvsztHB7Wjq54XYTJ2wp0pdFGoGxwHoqqk6v6ylEY4P4SDI8eUrqwwQYVyv9JwuBKeQuARnCrLwlqNUSbwoM-Qix8hyAlIyYAgdcU-yEpXRx246-dW73AHqMe333S3_38ugDEwNJFJqq1ZvtPPUN7MOLc2G1PIQKyP6f1mX96TdWeDoO1-ZtUy1MXJeK9_Jmf7r-MzLrMWdkHpS05hO2zL1bDihkQwsO3tNB2hScFXM4N0xKJphyUnf5a2RNE57XAMg2DwDiuYtHCeM4WtRn1rP49qFHyee392D7z8RMGPkw4e-dpGhAOTzwyDlvul5AqigPGvi8WdFjyAAS9MtG0B8pFJhEcnj_taUZrgiGyfoD88_hEMSyYVKg6_FNrd4sPtBaG2DbnIdSRH0Gq0W7Ju7qK/3po/kFr3Z9ZyRnGWwulZJhz5NA/h2/-I0GI_5u1Bm93Ky_qzaRiHQ2Mn0EkCw8bxgewRltHzk) and counting who have pledged to stand with us and oppose this dirty deal and demand it be uncoupled from the CR.
