As a devout member of the church and a trusted physician within my community, I can promise that I will selflessly represent you in Congress. It has been a privilege to represent the wonderful people of North Carolina, but I’m not ready to give up on this position just yet. | [](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=a98092143c914708af11ddce6939b152&_e=vFQyflHgG-6aq8VwnO94O150ATkxNysE4Qk7ezPiwjAcgdBsW1DtX3AkGSKHdu6PDnp-RMiVzKq5feFAi2K389pMVIxuMc7_x-GI04xLdDwIA7Ajf9YNTJjX2XbVtTAifm8swdIfN0Z8ewQZYLvrH5-Nhsmw69Kvsa-oLVZCSxy00uLRlwS7JECNgvEbiYUQVOZ8Sn-490yBk9eM5fJ4uixjKXaRmP-QUCNtOOaT2JWblNVpmZI_vy8PBLpOr-RHD0HdN7VCTjSBo5N8DaweAQmm1PqA14gMvHSHhxIxGZbgxHlw6Jlu0ACX9unNWm2ZExiL2_pC_vZwYD2KA1Z8cQ%3D%3D)

---
Peter,

Do you know _why_ I decided to become a doctor?

It’s because I knew that many people across the world and within our great country **desperately needed help**. I truly believe that God called on me to assist others during their times of hardship because he knew that I could carry the burdens of those I deliver aid to, improving their lives tremendously.

As a result, the past 35 years of my life have been spent in the medical field.

I graduated magna cum laude from Davidson College in 1985 and then graduated with honors from the UNC School of Medicine. I completed a surgical residency in Urology and Renal Transplantation at the University of Kentucky in Lexington and then opened up my own practice in Greenville, North Carolina, after moving there with my wife over 20 years ago.

I’ve traveled far and wide to places such as India, several parts of Africa, Nicaragua and Haiti as a Medical Missionary, serving both God and people from all walks of life. During this time, I was fortunate enough to meet Mother Teresa, who further inspired me to serve those in need.

My endeavors to lend a helping hand did not stop there. When Congressman Walter B. Jones, Jr. passed away in 2019 after 22 years of service and North Carolina was left without someone to represent their needs, **I felt called on to step up**.

For the past three years, I have been blessed to be able to serve the great people of North Carolina in Congress. Although this journey is a new one, I have learned it is not so different from working in the medical field. _**People want someone to care about their needs and take action to fix the issues that are causing them pain.**_

I excel as a congressman because I know how to take people’s problems into account, and work with individuals toward finding a solution that will result in them feeling great and living prosperously.

It has been a privilege to represent the wonderful people of North Carolina, _but I’m not ready to give up on this position just yet_. I wish to proceed with my duties and continue work on issues that are important to you.

In order for me to fulfill my earthly responsibility and keep North Carolina on course for prosperity, I must implore you to do something for me. [**Will you please stand behind me in solidarity with your financial support?**](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=a98092143c914708af11ddce6939b152&_e=vFQyflHgG-6aq8VwnO94O150ATkxNysE4Qk7ezPiwjAcgdBsW1DtX3AkGSKHdu6PDnp-RMiVzKq5feFAi2K389pMVIxuMc7_x-GI04xLdDwIA7Ajf9YNTJjX2XbVtTAifm8swdIfN0Z8ewQZYLvrH5-Nhsmw69Kvsa-oLVZCSxwwJ7f6WuKkPCg5YyX-2dvTmx6IOdOeNgGVFXgmt5DR1LrnC2pRZkqNWytU3qAbqAXBbCF-rWTFxEW0U4xbW4aN3Vc_pBfeIVZlQt8p4bDqKBK9b0kL7OUOuc6U3R0SKoq2Jm2I8hahW9YTRgQiOeXdq7lBAkK6e33xqjXF8Rut2Q%3D%3D)

[**STAND WITH GREG > **](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=a98092143c914708af11ddce6939b152&_e=vFQyflHgG-6aq8VwnO94O150ATkxNysE4Qk7ezPiwjAcgdBsW1DtX3AkGSKHdu6PDnp-RMiVzKq5feFAi2K389pMVIxuMc7_x-GI04xLdDwIA7Ajf9YNTJjX2XbVtTAifm8swdIfN0Z8ewQZYLvrH1Z_vFfj2eGcFhOdbdN9Jnm_bKxQqM4_XZbxUj0kVhuvobofaLI_W3APTO0xxHSGD2z7sj8KYHhDURrVhs6Y4biOV_EFFeRisJf_g1wBxzHAEV1r6UvqcUkjDZhyiOroES1Jzz3Sat4eHof03FNKPCqksbd1ruLoSm6lZ0CYYvH0AgQiUjeQFQ6Z8Xfc4wJ5vBpGHQoLO8lAksDkUAgMQy4%3D)
I am aware that what I’m asking may be difficult, but it is necessary – especially if we want to continue our hard work. It’s my calling to serve you, but [**I can’t do that with the Democrats in control of the House.**](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=a98092143c914708af11ddce6939b152&_e=vFQyflHgG-6aq8VwnO94O150ATkxNysE4Qk7ezPiwjAcgdBsW1DtX3AkGSKHdu6PDnp-RMiVzKq5feFAi2K389pMVIxuMc7_x-GI04xLdDwIA7Ajf9YNTJjX2XbVtTAifm8swdIfN0Z8ewQZYLvrH5-Nhsmw69Kvsa-oLVZCSxz3_zJgG85zAZSN6xQVl9RxQ4mhLIxwzsu7xChAbgHpyWPFhPGQd9xX0cJbFjV0kSDGCw_5K3O01VFfy7ycbzP_RvC_-Mf1JyjuKqpca3f4oJBUadZmYfK5POnK4QJB3wZwe95elXdF1gUUcCFh1jrr73HVF9t6SgfaU2GLzDCjpQ%3D%3D)

As a devout member of the church and a trusted physician within my community, I can promise that I will selflessly represent you in Congress. I will continue to advocate for your needs and champion North Carolina values – just as I advocate for my patients and for the word of God.

[**STAND WITH GREG > **](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=a98092143c914708af11ddce6939b152&_e=vFQyflHgG-6aq8VwnO94O150ATkxNysE4Qk7ezPiwjAcgdBsW1DtX3AkGSKHdu6PDnp-RMiVzKq5feFAi2K389pMVIxuMc7_x-GI04xLdDwIA7Ajf9YNTJjX2XbVtTAifm8swdIfN0Z8ewQZYLvrH1Z_vFfj2eGcFhOdbdN9Jnm_bKxQqM4_XZbxUj0kVhuvS3W8CxgDl9VzlbV4U4aBImG8vzFLUmy7B_rUYBoGc_IuI45TjrhC6GZpcC-yBXA7EKE3V0qIvKCESe9yL05lslY-pSuNDdVjbGlSsKqtU4GJT-N6DPDLrgLavhFkQkLtxQugAYGB-1tc9jvKmRM7xcnoZlz2EUKsWL_pgujlYG4%3D)

clean_body: As a devout member of the church and a trusted physician within my community, I can promise that I will selflessly represent you in Congress. It has been a privilege to represent the wonderful people of North Carolina, but I’m not ready to give up on this position just yet. | Peter, Do you know why I decided to become a doctor? It’s because I knew that many people across the world and within our great country desperately needed help. I truly believe that God called on me to assist others during their times of hardship because he knew that I could carry the burdens of those I deliver aid to, improving their lives tremendously. As a result, the past 35 years of my life have been spent in the medical field. I graduated magna cum laude from Davidson College in 1985 and then graduated with honors from the UNC School of Medicine. I completed a surgical residency in Urology and Renal Transplantation at the University of Kentucky in Lexington and then opened up my own practice in Greenville, North Carolina, after moving there with my wife over 20 years ago. I’ve traveled far and wide to places such as India, several parts of Africa, Nicaragua and Haiti as a Medical Missionary, serving both God and people from all walks of life. During this time, I was fortunate enough to meet Mother Teresa, who further inspired me to serve those in need. My endeavors to lend a helping hand did not stop there. When Congressman Walter B. Jones, Jr. passed away in 2019 after 22 years of service and North Carolina was left without someone to represent their needs, I felt called on to step up. For the past three years, I have been blessed to be able to serve the great people of North Carolina in Congress. Although this journey is a new one, I have learned it is not so different from working in the medical field. People want someone to care about their needs and take action to fix the issues that are causing them pain. I excel as a congressman because I know how to take people’s problems into account, and work with individuals toward finding a solution that will result in them feeling great and living prosperously. It has been a privilege to represent the wonderful people of North Carolina, but I’m not ready to give up on this position just yet. I wish to proceed with my duties and continue work on issues that are important to you. In order for me to fulfill my earthly responsibility and keep North Carolina on course for prosperity, I must implore you to do something for me. I am aware that what I’m asking may be difficult, but it is necessary – especially if we want to continue our hard work. It’s my calling to serve you, but As a devout member of the church and a trusted physician within my community, I can promise that I will selflessly represent you in Congress. I will continue to advocate for your needs and champion North Carolina values – just as I advocate for my patients and for the word of God. Together, I know we can build a nation affluent in conservative values. Thank you and God bless, Greg Murphy, MD | | Paid for by friends to elect Dr. Greg Murphy to Congress Murphy for Congress P.O. #

As one of our top supporters, we wanted to give an honest update on where our campaign stands today.
**THE SITUATION:** A 50/50 Senate is not cutting it, and North Carolina’s Senate race is one of Democrats’ absolute best chances to expand the majority.
**THE NUMBERS:** Poll after poll consistently shows that North Carolina’s Senate race is in a statistical tie. A very small number of votes could be decisive here, just like in Cheri’s last statewide race.

Friend – I want you to hear this from me first: **_MSNBC_ expert Steve Kornacki just reported on a brand-new poll that shows me 2 points down against my opponent Herschel Walker.**
With _FiveThirtyEight_ saying our race will likely decide Senate control, we have absolutely zero room for error. **[Will you split $3 or more between my campaign and Maggie Hassan's before our upcoming deadline so we can keep Georgia and the Senate blue?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51174785/368487712/-323915468?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&refcode=mh-jtk1699-bu-nd&recurring=0&amount=3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0ZGQ5Y2RhYi1kMjNhLWVkMTEtYTI3Yy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=HGYr92JyIcVnKlpg6S8jw8LgS7vCNTH03D85tdlyiPs=)**

You probably saw Al in a viral clip just last week, explaining to a flustered Republican on CNN that two Supreme Court seats were stolen by Mitch McConnell & Donald Trump, and therefore this Court is illegitimate. _ _So, as they say in the business Al used to be in, Senator Franken, take it away!......._ __ Dear Person Who Still Opens My Email, I hardly ever ask anything of you. Unless you’re also on my other list of people who I constantly ask to contribute to something I don’t think I can legally mention here. | Josh was my Judiciary Committee counsel, and I cannot say enough good things about him. But here’s some. Josh grew up in the district in a working-class neighborhood of Endicott, NY. After graduating from Harvard Law School, Josh moved to Florida to work on a landmark civil rights lawsuit representing kids from low-income families who were having difficulty accessing the healthcare services they needed. Josh really, really cares about all the stuff I care about. Josh is the hardest worker I know. Together we passed bills expanding rights for survivors of domestic abuse and providing new funding for addiction treatment and mental health programs. We also made a lot of Republican witnesses look very bad. Josh is my friend. And finally, this open seat is considered one of the most competitive in the nation. **[Control of the House is up for grabs. Please help Josh win this one for all of us.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T55ca7dd2-89a7-42b0-b083-0c379111a5d2/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)** This is important. To me. And to our nation. subject: Do you remember the DCCC blacklist?

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter, do you
remember the DCCC blacklist?
After AOC defeated one of the most powerful, entrenched incumbents in
Congress, the DCCC announced a new policy that would blacklist vendors who
worked with candidates who ran primary campaigns against incumbent
Democrats.

Two of our recruits, Cori Bush and Jamaal Bowman, still defeated long-time
corporate incumbents in 2020 while the DCCC Blacklist was in effect. We
were not afraid of the Democratic establishment and with your support, we
continued to win races despite the odds stacked against us.

The DCCC announced an end to the blacklist after the 2020 elections — it
was more of a PR nightmare for them than an effective tool against
progressive primaries.

Even though the DCCC officially ended their blacklist policy, we’re still
not surprised House Speaker Nancy Pelosi supported conservative,
anti-abortion and pro-NRA Democrat Henry Cuellar against Justice Democrat
Jessica Cisneros. She lost by fewer than 300 votes.

We don’t just need more Democrats in Congress, but BETTER Democrats.

While we fight for Medicare for All and a Green New Deal, corporate
Democrats like Pelosi, Cuellar, and many others will try to protect
corporate profits and the status quo. Peter,
will you donate today to help us re-elect
the Squad in November and even grow our bloc in Congress?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/114348?refcode=em20220922-25241&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=25241%2E1203867%2EP69KAv ]→ Yes, I can contribute right now to help Justice Democrats overcome
the odds and grow the Squad in Congress.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/114348?refcode=em20220922-25241&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1021&akid=25241%2E1203867%2EP69KAv ]Contribute

Thank you for all that you do to support our work and our primary
candidates.

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that
this is a difficult time. If you’re struggling, you can find a food bank
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/28883?t=1022&akid=25241%2E1203867%2EP69KAv ]here. We appreciate everything you do to keep our movement strong.

Please stay informed and follow the most up-to-date recommendations from the
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/24438?t=1023&akid=25241%2E1203867%2EP69KAv ]Centers for Disease Control and your state public health department.

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property. After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. It has been a privilege to represent the wonderful people of North Carolina, but I’m not ready to give up on this position just yet. | [](http://links.stoppingsocialistdems.com/u/click?_t=4dcc2aab65fd4d0da6a107b0eef86d43&_m=3a88c3f64f884807a3b2dd8eff99da91&_e=coYip6eRbDPNcqZSWkWsWyX_VmVVKrGJIK6-TnmT0GKFm23TgA3Pmv4NvWCnX_BQLpKhijcldlN4tWXQPVILDb4UJQTEifum2y0EdqpDyr6mU9krS5yNpnvNaQEPJprKUtdPpwbEwZOPpVifET67vwBVIx43en0AtdIvyodl6pJUuJ7A2HjE_bCEO-5_LC6V_RlGeo3nkLy3EDZK6WLNbtD7K2YDSWTL05wGCqn-JWQNe9X-rKdHthywHUWXCe5SA0EpgwribQn_oDeobYKc54KVzP9Ejy-gpRg6EWr_izJ3MBxQw4Qetbg-wZSV3nEz)

Peter,

Do you know _why_ I decided to become a doctor?

It’s because I knew that many people across the world and within our great country **desperately needed help**. I truly believe that God called on me to assist others during their times of hardship because he knew that I could carry the burdens of those I deliver aid to, improving their lives tremendously.

As a result, the past 35 years of my life have been spent in the medical field.

I graduated magna cum laude from Davidson College in 1985 and then graduated with honors from the UNC School of Medicine. I completed a surgical residency in Urology and Renal Transplantation at the University of Kentucky in Lexington and then opened up my own practice in Greenville, North Carolina, after moving there with my wife over 20 years ago.

I’ve traveled far and wide to places such as India, several parts of Africa, Nicaragua and Haiti as a Medical Missionary, serving both God and people from all walks of life. During this time, I was fortunate enough to meet Mother Teresa, who further inspired me to serve those in need.

My endeavors to lend a helping hand did not stop there. When Congressman Walter B. Jones, Jr. passed away in 2019 after 22 years of service and North Carolina was left without someone to represent their needs, **I felt called on to step up**.

For the past three years, I have been blessed to be able to serve the great people of North Carolina in Congress. Although this journey is a new one, I have learned it is not so different from working in the medical field. _**People want someone to care about their needs and take action to fix the issues that are causing them pain.**_

I excel as a congressman because I know how to take people’s problems into account, and work with individuals toward finding a solution that will result in them feeling great and living prosperously.

It has been a privilege to represent the wonderful people of North Carolina, _but I’m not ready to give up on this position just yet_. I wish to proceed with my duties and continue work on issues that are important to you.

In order for me to fulfill my earthly responsibility and keep North Carolina on course for prosperity, I must implore you to do something for me. body:
Gun violence is an epidemic in our country, but it’s a problem I’m committed to solving.

# [](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/144?t=2&akid=964%2E61531%2EAS-UbP)
Hello,
The day after the 2018 Parkland shootings, we came within an eyelash of having a mass shooting at a school in Fair Haven, Vermont. Our state has a long tradition of responsible gun use, but things in this country have changed deeply, and it’s past time we begin addressing those changes.
We’re facing a serious gun violence crisis in America, and the gun manufacturers themselves are largely at fault. During a House Oversight Committee hearing last month, I got the chance to speak to a couple of these manufacturers, and I refused to back down when they tried to avoid answering my questions.
I’m not dropping this issue any time soon, Friend, and it’s a fight I’ll be looking to win as Vermont’s next senator. But first, we’ve got to win this November’s election, and there’s not a moment to waste if we’re going to make it happen.
[**Our best chance at holding the gun manufacturers accountable and rethinking our gun laws is through a Democratic majority, and this Vermont Senate seat could make all the difference. If you’re able, please pitch in $5 or anything you can to power us to victory.**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/4254?t=3&akid=964%2E61531%2EAS-UbP)
_If you’ve saved payment info with ActBlue Express, your donation will process automatically:_

---

On the other hand, my opponent is against any additional gun control measures at all. If he’s elected, he’ll help Mitch McConnell bring this fight to a standstill, and there are far too many lives at stake for us to let this issue die on the vine.
The gun control legislation we’ve already passed this year has given us major momentum that we can build on, and that’s why winning this Senate seat is so important for the future of our state and our country. Whether it's gun manufacturers, the NRA, or Mitch McConnell himself, you can always count on me to stand up for you and ask the tough questions. I never stop fighting for our shared values, and I will bring that mindset to the Senate.
[**Gun violence is an epidemic in our country, but it’s a problem I’m committed to solving. Help me keep this issue alive in the Senate by making a $5 donation to our campaign today.**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/4254?t=7&akid=964%2E61531%2EAS-UbP)
Thanks again for all you do,
Peter

name: John Fetterman
subject: You’re not an ATM
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
🥰🥰🥰
#
Hey Derek, quick question — do you get emails from any other Democratic politicians?
If so, I know you probably get a *lot* of emails. And we’re sure a lot of them do the same thing we do: **Ask for your support.**
So I just want to say, and I truly mean this, I know you’re not an ATM machine. We know real people support our campaign — teachers, nurses, veterans, single parents, retirees, and activists including you, Derek.
That’s why I don’t allow our campaign to lie or use scare tactics in our online fundraising emails.
We’ll never trick you into a recurring donation or pressure you with shining promises of 15X matches (which don’t actually exist). Every deadline we share is a real fundraising deadline that is either set by our finance team or by the Federal Election Commission.
**But here’s what I will do:** Humbly ask for your support so we can win our campaign.
If Democrats are going to scrap the filibuster, codify _Roe v. Wade_ , and pass crucial voting rights legislation, then I gotta be in the Senate to deliver that 51st vote. 💯
If we are going to show Dr. Oz and MAGA Republicans that they can’t buy our vote, then we need to do absolutely everything we can to flip PA blue.
A huge part of that is raising as much money as possible we can online. That’s why I gotta ask:
**[By making a donation of any amount today, you’re supporting our grassroots campaign to elect me + send Dr. Oz packing. So please, chip in what you can, Derek.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220922-2?amount=5&refcode=em20220922-7353&refcode2=7353_434096_TB7c9k&akid=7353%2E434096%2ETB7c9k)**
**[Contribute](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220922-2?amount=5&refcode=em20220922-7353&refcode2=7353_434096_TB7c9k&akid=7353%2E434096%2ETB7c9k)**
Thank you so much.
— John ❤️
John Fetterman
Lieutenant Governor of Pennsylvania
Democratic Nominee for U.S. Senate

As it turns out, _The View_ is as predictable as it is liberal. I’ve told my story many times. I’m the proud daughter of Indian immigrants — but I was an outsider growing up in rural South Carolina. I was a brown girl in a black-and-white world. My family faced stares, whispers, and exclusion. But then something very American happened. The community looked beyond skin color. They got to know my family as hard-working people who shared their values. Slowly, those stares turned into smiles, and the whispers turned into friendships. **I haven’t just seen the American story. I’ve lived the American story.** As the first female and first minority governor of South Carolina I know deep in my bones that America is not a racist country. But the liberal hosts on _The View_ can’t look past their narrow, identity politics. They went after me for using my middle name — an Indian name no less — and accused me of trying to run away from my heritage. Nothing could be further from the truth, but Hollywood liberals on _The View_ don’t care about the truth.
[**Friend, it’s time to fight back against the media and hypocritical Democrats. That's why you and I must call the media out and continue to protect the values and principles that make our country special. Will you please chip in to stand up to the liberal media and elect strong Republicans?**](https://links.standforamericanow.com/u/click?_t=d85fab909a98477596691a746a1de4c5&_m=e8d26d3ee8754cc59719cdb78e80ca62&_e=nU2OA5TdhcMQAwx8g1Ek-Dje39tpCqZ5NWIKvbopIRXiGr0RruPOksNOmlPfJ8_UBpS-0OPZT1VUcxkO_sIsBvBn7obM-vLPqEoVtSCxHpS0UxSkDG364iIlQhaRKLPALMPBlYkd6KgeB0Sag1KbKsAtN4nukWEqM3zyafmltCaZOJ-BNYpdUDm9ME1a-qOE83HdZiQOShDy7MKeMsOD1AvNwBjNpde1wEDJllvyKdaMgjQ8xZ9et9UsnylNFuj0nxO-t2EZHD1C2iHk-MeiY4yKu8ZrhHysZSEuqSNBFudMBXrw1gV8ZTDTA8tWphiyQvqCFGXe2hk_LQb8HMIAQf5qoxnecjFn1we5Dq_OrctqyPlgrosGvuhn5ke-2ux7) You see, the liberal media’s aim is two-fold...
1. Divide and weaken the Right
2. Distract from the disaster that is the Biden-Harris administration

The only way to stop the Left is at the ballot box on Election Day. You have heard me say it before, but this effort starts now. clean_body: | | | Friend, As it turns out, The View is as predictable as it is liberal. I’ve told my story many times. I’m the proud daughter of Indian immigrants — but I was an outsider growing up in rural South Carolina. I was a brown girl in a black-and-white world. My family faced stares, whispers, and exclusion. But then something very American happened. The community looked beyond skin color. They got to know my family as hard-working people who shared their values. Slowly, those stares turned into smiles, and the whispers turned into friendships. I haven’t just seen the American story. I’ve lived the American story. As the first female and first minority governor of South Carolina I know deep in my bones that America is not a racist country. But the liberal hosts on The View can’t look past their narrow, identity politics. They went after me for using my middle name — an Indian name no less — and accused me of trying to run away from my heritage. Nothing could be further from the truth, but Hollywood liberals on The View don’t care about the truth. You see, the liberal media’s aim is two-fold... 1. Divide and weaken the Right 2. Distract from the disaster that is the Biden-Harris administration The only way to stop the Left is at the ballot box on Election Day. You have heard me say it before, but this effort starts now. Not only are we up against the Democrats and their massive fundraising advantage, but we are also up against the bias of the liberal media. I won’t back down. As long as I have a voice, I’ll keep standing for you and this country. I need you on my team. My very best, Nikki R. Haley | | | NIKKI IS COMING TO A CITY NEAR YOU! Exclusive Message from Nikki When I was growing up, smart, strong, and unconventional women were discouraged. When I ran for office, the South Carolina legislature was dominated by a Good Old Boys Club and my opponent thought that women didn’t belong in politics. People thought I was too brown...too female...too young...too conservative...too principled... Well, I said: Too bad! I was inspired by great women who broke barriers and defied expectations, women like Margaret Thatcher and Jeane Kirkpatrick. I want to share the stories of these incredible women with you and hope you will be inspired, too. **Life saving insulin should be affordable for all Americans.**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51171136/368472036/-695644649?source=direct_link&referrer=group-derek-marshall-for-congress&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fpl_derekmarshall%3Famount%3D10%26refcode%3Dpl_20220922_08%26noskip%3Dtrue&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODEyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhM2UxMDEzOC1jMjNhLWVkMTEtYTI3Yy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=sfPCm84tBkADMspnUAxTon41CsnwDABbzeI_zfnPc1Y=&emci=bb44019e-853a-ed11-a27c-281878b83d8a&emdi=a3e10138-c23a-ed11-a27c-281878b83d8a&ceid=21617867)**[Tell Congress to save lives - CAP Insulin prices!](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51171137/368472037/-695644649?source=direct_link&referrer=group-derek-marshall-for-congress&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fpl_derekmarshall%3Famount%3D10%26refcode%3Dpl_20220922_08%26noskip%3Dtrue&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODEyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhM2UxMDEzOC1jMjNhLWVkMTEtYTI3Yy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=sfPCm84tBkADMspnUAxTon41CsnwDABbzeI_zfnPc1Y=&emci=bb44019e-853a-ed11-a27c-281878b83d8a&emdi=a3e10138-c23a-ed11-a27c-281878b83d8a&ceid=21617867)**

Approximately 1 million insulin users are on private insurance, and there is no cap on the cost of insulin for them. The cost to produce a month’s worth of insulin is $4-$12, but the cost to consumers ranges from $50-$1000 a month.
People are **_dying_** due to the outrageous cost of insulin, yet Republicans including Derek’s Republican opponent Jay Obernolte, have voted **_against_** the $35 cap on insulin for people on private insurance.
**Democrats have made attempts to cap insulin for everyone, but without a filibuster proof majority, it gets killed in the Senate by Republicans. Congress can save lives by passing a $35 cap on insulin prices.

[Sign the petition DEMANDING Congress put a cap on insulin prices! Price gouging is killing people!](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51171138/368472038/-695644649?source=direct_link&referrer=group-derek-marshall-for-congress&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fpl_derekmarshall%3Famount%3D10%26refcode%3Dpl_20220922_08%26noskip%3Dtrue&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODEyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhM2UxMDEzOC1jMjNhLWVkMTEtYTI3Yy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=sfPCm84tBkADMspnUAxTon41CsnwDABbzeI_zfnPc1Y=&emci=bb44019e-853a-ed11-a27c-281878b83d8a&emdi=a3e10138-c23a-ed11-a27c-281878b83d8a&ceid=21617867)**

Century old insulin costs 8 times more in the US than in peer countries. A study by CharityRx found 79% of Americans with diabetes have taken on credit card debt to pay for insulin, with an average debt of $9000.

More than 100,000 Americans died in 2021 from diabetes. More than 30 million Americans are diagnosed with diabetes, 7 million require daily insulin. One in four Americans have reported rationing due to high costs, which can be fatal.

**Americans and Democrats support a cap on the cost of insulin. Republicans, beholden to Big Pharma money, are obstructing this life saving legislation. Tell them to support a cap on insulin prices!

[Sign the petition and tell Congress to put a cap on insulin for EVERYONE now! It will save lives! Its a no brainer!](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51171139/368472039/-695644649?source=direct_link&referrer=group-derek-marshall-for-congress&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fpl_derekmarshall%3Famount%3D10%26refcode%3Dpl_20220922_08%26noskip%3Dtrue&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODEyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhM2UxMDEzOC1jMjNhLWVkMTEtYTI3Yy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=sfPCm84tBkADMspnUAxTon41CsnwDABbzeI_zfnPc1Y=&emci=bb44019e-853a-ed11-a27c-281878b83d8a&emdi=a3e10138-c23a-ed11-a27c-281878b83d8a&ceid=21617867)**

name: Ron Johnson
subject: Just your endorsement ➡️
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ron Johnson For Senate, Inc
body:
I decided to run for the U.S. Senate in 2010 because growing entitlements and out-of-control federal spending had exploded our national debt to $14 trillion.
|
---
| | | Peter,

I decided to run for the U.S. Senate in 2010 because growing entitlements and out-of-control federal spending had exploded our national debt to $14 trillion. We were on an unsustainable path that was mortgaging our children's future.

Fortunately, Americans decided that a government controlled by liberal Democrats wasn't good for the country, and they elected Republicans to the House to halt President Obama's extreme policies. A Republican majority in the Senate followed in 2014.

As I ran for re-election in 2016, we had the prospect of electing a Republican president who could work with a Republican Congress not only to stop the expansion of liberal policies but, we hoped, to reverse some of the damage done during Mr. Obama's administration. I figured we had an opportunity to put America back on the right path, and I was more than willing to dedicate myself to that worthy effort.

By and large, Republican policies worked. Regulatory relief and a more competitive tax system helped create a healthy economy with low inflation and record low unemployment. Strengthening the military deterred our enemies, and policies designed to secure the borders dramatically reduced the flow of illegal immigration.

During the 2016 campaign, I said it would be my last campaign and final term. That was my strong preference, and my wife's--we both looked forward to a normal private life. However, neither of us anticipated the Democrats' complete takeover of government and the disastrous policies they have already inflicted on America and the world, to say nothing of those they threaten to enact in the future.

Nor did we anticipate the pandemic, the government's failed response to it, the loss of freedom that has resulted, and the tyrannical approach taken by the elites who have created and maintained a state of fear that allows them to exercise control over Americans' lives. Instead of everyone working to achieve the goal President Biden stated during his inaugural address--unifying and healing America--it feels as if our nation is being torn apart.

As I travel around Wisconsin and talk to citizens who love our country, I know I am not the only one with grave concerns. My message has always been that America is precious, and it is our solemn duty to make sure it survives and thrives for future generations.

President Reagan warned that freedom is fragile, always one generation away from extinction. As I have told crowds since my first Tea Party speeches in 2010: This is a fight for freedom. This is not someone else's fight, this is our fight, and it's a fight we absolutely must win.

I believe America is in peril. Much as I'd like to ease into a quiet retirement, I don't feel I should. Countless people have encouraged me to run, saying they rely on me to be their voice, to speak plain and obvious truths other elected leaders shirk from expressing--truths the elite in government, mainstream media, and Big Tech don't want you to hear.

In 2010 I promised I would always tell people the truth and that I would never vote with re-election in mind. When re-election isn't your primary motivation, those are easy promises to keep. Today, I am announcing I will continue to fight for freedom in the public realm by running for re-election. It is a decision I haven't made lightly. Having already experienced a growing level of vitriol and false attacks, I certainly don't expect better treatment in the future. For my campaign to succeed, I will need the support of every American who values the truth and refuses to allow lies and distortions to prevail.

Tens of millions of dollars will be spent trying to destroy and defeat me. The mainstream media and Big Tech will contribute their powerful and corrupt voices as the unofficial but reliable communication apparatus of the Democrats. We face powerful forces that desire even more power and control over our lives. Their path, paved with false hope and greater dependency, always leads to tyranny. We cannot let them win.

So I will humbly ask for your endorsement to help me SAVE AMERICA.
---

Ron Johnson

subject: Weekly Newsletter: Endorsed by DuPage County Sheriff James Mendrick
body:
KeithPekau.com |
---
| | [ ](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=3a154ffc55&e=7dd0b93d07)
---
| |
---
| Peter,

This week, our campaign was honored to announce the endorsement of DuPage County Sheriff James Mendrick.

In his statement, Mendrick said:
_“Keith Pekau is what a real law and order mayor looks like. He is a leader who cares more about the safety of his citizens, law enforcement officers, and has actively been working against those who are soft on crime and wish to dismantle the police,” Mendrick said in a statement.

“While crime rates are rising at alarming levels across the rest of Cook County, crime rates in Orland Park have dropped to their lowest rates in 27 years. Under Pekau's leadership, Orland Park has flourished. People are keeping their families there, and over 600 new businesses have opened in Orland Park in the past 5 years. They’re moving to Orland Park because they know that with Mayor Pekau at the helm, they will be safe. His common-sense leadership has served his community very well. I am endorsing Keith, and fully supporting his campaign to take his smart, no-nonsense approach to public safety to Congress. I know he will be a leader in restoring peace on American streets and making our families safe.” _

With over 25 years in law enforcement, Sheriff Mendrick is a well-respected figure in DuPage County, the second largest county in Illinois. His innovative approach to law enforcement has made DuPage County safer, reduced the rates of recidivism and relapse among ex-offenders, empowered ex-offenders to become self-sufficient through workplace readiness preparation and skills development.

Mendrick leads 400 sworn officers and 100 civilian employees.

I’m honored to receive the Sheriff’s endorsement. He has dedicated his life to serving his community. Thanks to his hard work and leadership, residents in DuPage live their lives in peace knowing that the Sheriff’s office is working to keep them safe. I look forward to continuing to work together to restore safety on our streets.

Thank you,

Keith Pekau
_Mayor of Orland Park
Republican Nominee for Illinois’ Sixth Congressional District_
---
|
---
| _**In Case You Missed It**_
**Press Release: Pekau Announces Innovative Program to Keep Orland Park Safe, Despite Kim Foxx, Sean Casten and the SAFE-T Act**
Orland Park Mayor Keith Pekau has announced an innovative policing program designed to keep his community safe in the era of Kim Foxx and Sean Casten’s anti-police, pro-criminal efforts, and - of course - the insane SAFE-T Act.
---
| [ ](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=ffaf366497&e=7dd0b93d07)
---
| The initiative is a first-of-its-kind agreement with the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives (ATF) that makes two Orland Park police officers part-time ATF agents. The partnership will allow the local officers to take applicable cases straight to the Assistant US Attorney, and bypass Cook County and the dangerous stipulations of the Safe-T Act, to get federal charges against violent criminals.

Pekau said of the partnership, _“Federal prosecutors WILL prosecute these crimes and Federal judges CAN use bail to detain violent criminals and KEEP them off the street.

“Even better, it does not impact our budget or commit our officers to do anything we do not want them to do. This is yet another example of our outstanding police department finding ways to keep you safe. Creative programs like the Mobile and Targeted Response Units, and now this are why we have the lowest index crimes in 27 years and were the 8th safest small city in the United States.

“This is great work and why I will continue to say we have the best Police Department in the State. I applaud the leadership of the department, our village and our board.

Together, we will continue to fight the dangerous public safety policies of Kim Foxx, JB Pritzker, and our Congressional representation and do everything in our power to keep you safe.” _

[Watch the video of Pekau’s Statement here.](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=d61374d7c2&e=7dd0b93d07)

Pekau’s tireless efforts to build relationships between various law enforcement agencies, as well as between private businesses and citizens has resulted in the lowest crime rates in Orland Park in 27 years. His work stands in stark contrast to the efforts of Congressman Sean Casten, who has voted for numerous measures that make communities less safe.

For example, Casten co-sponsored the federal bill to handcuff police and protect criminals, entitled ‘The Justice in Policing” Act, as well as voting against the federal ban on Fentanyl.

On the issue of public safety, the choice in IL-06 is clear: Keith Pekau has made his community more safe. Sean Casten has put us all at risk.

[Watch Keith’s interview on Fox Chicago here.](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=342ba44bc3&e=7dd0b93d07)

**The Sara Carter Show: Pro-Criminals Policies Put Familes at Risk**
Mayor Keith Pekau joins the Sara Carter Show to expose the danger of radical leftist crime policies that endanger our communities.

[Watch the segment here.](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=29ae1436a2&e=7dd0b93d07)

---
|
# **_Connecting the Dots_**
---
| **CBS-2: Gov. Pritzker, AG Raoul Sued by Two Counties Claiming the SAFE-T Act is Unconstitutional**
The Kankakee and Will County State's Attorneys are suing Illinois Governor J.B. Pritzker and Attorney General Kwame Raoul to declare the Safe-T Act unconstitutional.

The Safe-T Act, which will go into effect in January, brings major criminal justice reform.

[Read the full story here.](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=f82ce88f57&e=7dd0b93d07)

**Keith’s Comment:** _This barely passed because many Democrats know this is a bad idea.
Unfortunately at the state level in Orland Park, Senators Michael Hastings & Emil Jones, Representative Slaughter and Governor Pritzker think that risking the safety of citizens is OK.

This mimics the national policies espoused by Sean Casten and Joe Biden that leave borders open, seek to decriminalize fentanyl and prioritize criminals ahead of public safety.

Let's hope they win in court._

From city council, to mayor, to running for Governor, I’m proud to have always put Ohioans first
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51172242/368476402/1144435635?refcode=nw_em_templateheader&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODM5MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4ZTM0ZWFjYi1jNjNhLWVkMTEtYTI3Yy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ZzGu3csYeedrXgW3DFN_SExxJv4QLeAOqltiKvftRXM=)

Team,
I’ve been working to build a better Ohio for a long time.
Between being on city council, to being elected Mayor of Dayton, and now running for Governor, there’s a lot of things I’m proud of that I’ve accomplished for folks in the state.
As commissioner, I helped midsize cities in Ohio that were left behind recover from the predatory lending crisis. Then when I was Mayor, I passed high quality preschool for every four year old and restored one of Dayton’s most cherished buildings — the arcade — revitalizing the area and creating a community hub right in the heart of the city.
I’ve always looked out for everyday Ohions, the ones who worry about how they can buy a home, where they can send their kids to school, and how they’ll find a job in their city to pay for their family’s groceries.
**Creating a better Ohio is what I’ve dedicated my life to doing. But after all these years, there’s still more to be done,[_which is why I’m running for Governor._](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51172243/368476403/-657032799?refcode=nw_em_220922_1_t2&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&firstname=&lastname=&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODM5MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4ZTM0ZWFjYi1jNjNhLWVkMTEtYTI3Yy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ZzGu3csYeedrXgW3DFN_SExxJv4QLeAOqltiKvftRXM=)**
Now there are new priorities I’m focusing on in our state. I’m working to take meaningful action to end gun violence, fighting to end a radical abortion ban and ensuring reproductive freedom for all, and getting corruption out of our state government.
Meanwhile my opponent is putting guns in schools, endangering the lives of Ohioans by forcing people to go out-of-state to seek care, and cozying up to his corrupt, special interest friends pushing their radical, right-wing agendas.
**[I’m proud of what I’ve done for Ohio. But my work here isn’t done yet and the stakes are higher than ever, which is why I’m asking for your support: Please, can you rush $5 to my campaign right now so I can keep putting Ohioans first?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51172244/368476404/-657032799?refcode=nw_em_220922_1_t2&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&firstname=&lastname=&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODM5MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4ZTM0ZWFjYi1jNjNhLWVkMTEtYTI3Yy0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ZzGu3csYeedrXgW3DFN_SExxJv4QLeAOqltiKvftRXM=)**
Onward,
Nan Whaley

Peter, I wanted to send you a quick battlefield update on where we are on getting our ads up on the air.

A few days ago we announced that we needed help getting our ads on the air, and since then, the response has been overwhelming.

I can’t tell you how lucky I am to have you in my corner, Peter. **Because of the support from members of Team Cao, we've made progress toward raising the funds to launch our new ads...but, our work is far from over.**

Virginia is one of the most expensive media markets in the country, which means our ads are _more expensive_ to get on the air than in most races.

name: Tiffany Smiley
subject: This is a long, but very personal message 📧
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Smiley for Washington, Inc
body:
| |
---
| | | Peter,

My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I'm running for the U.S. Senate in Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my family's farm and learned the value of hard work.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61370413:JC2WLJVFN:m:1:3331421248:7373670831C7A11324AE6D4EBA6D606B:r "I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of hard work.")
---

I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping others in need.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61370413:JC2WLJVFN:m:1:3331421248:7373670831C7A11324AE6D4EBA6D606B:r "I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College")
---

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61370413:JC2WLJVFN:m:1:3331421248:7373670831C7A11324AE6D4EBA6D606B:r "I married my high school sweetheart Scotty")
---

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever, Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty's side.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61370413:JC2WLJVFN:m:1:3331421248:7373670831C7A11324AE6D4EBA6D606B:r "Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq")
---

When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on the spot, consenting to Scotty's immediate discharge from the Army.
_**I refused. **_
Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61370413:JC2WLJVFN:m:1:3331421248:7373670831C7A11324AE6D4EBA6D606B:r "Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and
every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.")
---

Scotty went on to serve as America's first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61370413:JC2WLJVFN:m:1:3331421248:7373670831C7A11324AE6D4EBA6D606B:r "Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind
active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way. ")
---

It's not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way--_and won._

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61370413:JC2WLJVFN:m:1:3331421248:7373670831C7A11324AE6D4EBA6D606B:r "I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an
advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.")
---

In 2007, we welcomed our first child. While Scotty will never be able to 'see' our children's faces, he's always been an incredible father and hero to our boys.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61370413:JC2WLJVFN:m:1:3331421248:7373670831C7A11324AE6D4EBA6D606B:r "In 2007, we welcomed our first child.")
---

Now, our family is taking on a new challenge. I'm running for US Senate to help families across the country achieve the American Dream and save our country from Joe Biden and Patty Murray.

I will take the same fight and optimistic spirit I've shown throughout my life to help Washington families secure a better life. I believe that now, more than ever, Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61370413:JC2WLJVFN:m:1:3331421248:7373670831C7A11324AE6D4EBA6D606B:r "Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique
problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.")
---

My family began this journey in the halls of Walter Reed and we look forward to continuing this journey in the halls of the United States Capitol.

I would love for the next photo in this story to be us winning this race with my family by my side.

We can't do that, however, without your help, Peter. _**[So please, can you chip in just a few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we've achieved so far.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61370413:JC2WLJVFN:m:1:3331421248:7373670831C7A11324AE6D4EBA6D606B:r "So please, can you chip in just a
few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we’ve achieved so far. ")**_

---
| | | [KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61370413:JC2WLJVFN:m:1:3331421248:7373670831C7A11324AE6D4EBA6D606B:r "KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT")
---
| | | [STAND UP FOR AMERICA](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61370413:JC2WLJVFN:m:1:3331421248:7373670831C7A11324AE6D4EBA6D606B:r "STAND UP FOR AMERICA")
---

I know with your support we can win this.

Sincerely,

Tiffany Smiley

---
| |

---
* * *
---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61370414:JC2WLJVFN:m:1:3331421248:7373670831C7A11324AE6D4EBA6D606B:r "All Eyes On Washington")
---
Hey, it's Tiffany Smiley.

The Washington Senate race is now the #1 battleground race in the COUNTRY!

Needless to say, all eyes are on us. We are in the FINAL DAYS until the November election, and Patty Murray is flooding millions into our state.

We are in an uphill battle, and I can't make it up to the top without you. Not just Washingtonians, but all Americans deserve a real leader with real solutions. Together, we can ensure that the American Dream is not lost.

_**[Rush support now to be a part of history](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61370414:JC2WLJVFN:m:1:3331421248:7373670831C7A11324AE6D4EBA6D606B:r "Rush support now to be a part of
history")**_.

Let's raise money and WIN,

Tiffany Smiley

---
| | | [JOIN TEAM SMILEY](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61370414:JC2WLJVFN:m:1:3331421248:7373670831C7A11324AE6D4EBA6D606B:r "JOIN TEAM SMILEY")
---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61370415:JC2WLJVFN:m:1:3331421248:7373670831C7A11324AE6D4EBA6D606B:r "Alert!")
---

Team Smiley here with a RED ALERT!

You know we don't often beg, plead, or panic, but Tiffany is facing a key deadline, and we're OUT of time.

Whether or not you choose to act will decide the outcome of the Washington U.S. Senate Election:

Tiffany is currently being outraised and outspent by her 30-year incumbent opponent. We need all hands on deck to turn things around TODAY.

There's no time to wait on the sidelines.

_**[That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61370416:JC2WLJVFN:m:1:3331421248:7373670831C7A11324AE6D4EBA6D606B:r "That's why we're HUMBLY asking for
your help in the next 15 minutes!")**_

This is our only chance to make history and restore a brighter future for Washington and all of America. We need Tiffany Smiley in the U.S. Senate, plain and simple.

Our team doesn't want to have to deliver bad news to Tiffany later today, so we're calling on our grassroots team, including YOU, to help increase our momentum!

Tiffany is a veterans' advocate and mother of 3! She is the new, fresh leadership we desperately need in Washington! Tiffany will be your #1 supporter in the U.S. Senate.

We're out of time. There's nowhere else to turn. Tiffany needs us at this moment. _**[Step up now!](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61370416:JC2WLJVFN:m:1:3331421248:7373670831C7A11324AE6D4EBA6D606B:r "Step up now!")**_

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61370417:JC2WLJVFN:m:1:3331421248:7373670831C7A11324AE6D4EBA6D606B:r "Scan here for a personal message from Tiffany!")
---
_Scan to reveal a message from Tiffany Smiley._
---

---

Richland, WA, 99352

name: Pramila Jayapal
subject: Let's be clear about what's happening at the border
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
The Republicans couldn't care less about immigrants.
#
Peter,
As a proud immigrant, I am infuriated.
Using migrants and their families to score political points is unbecoming of any elected official. But now it's a part of the GOP playbook. **Every election cycle, Republicans become more and more emboldened with their hateful agenda.**
It’s bad enough that they do everything in their power to stir up resentment against immigrants simply seeking a better life, often escaping terrible conditions and risking everything to come here. **Now Republicans are trying to turn migrants and refugees into political pawns just in time for the midterm elections.**
GOP governors are pulling stunts that are confusing, manipulating, and now trafficking migrants as a campaign tactic. **It’s cynical, power-hungry, and just plain wrong.** We cannot let Republicans define the narrative on “border security” when real lives are at stake.
[**And they pretend they had nothing to do with the conditions that force people to leave everything they have behind. But we know better:**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/17619?t=1&akid=1645%2E420207%2E-3CFPu)
[](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/17619?t=2&akid=1645%2E420207%2E-3CFPu)
**We can’t and won’t let them get away with treating peoples’ lives as a political game.**
Building an immigration system rooted in humane, compassionate, and evidence-based policy is a cause near and dear to my heart. Before I came to Congress, I founded the largest immigrants' rights organization in Washington State.
And as Chair of the Congressional Progressive Caucus, I have pushed for years to prioritize immigration reform that centers human dignity and respect. Now and always, **I will continue to fight for an America that treats everyone with decency and equality** \- the country we all deserve.
I hope you are with me.
In solidarity,
Pramila

name: Ron Johnson
subject: Just your endorsement
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ron Johnson For Senate, Inc
body:
I decided to run for the U.S. Senate in 2010 because growing entitlements and out-of-control federal spending had exploded our national debt to $14 trillion.
|
---
| | | Peter,

I decided to run for the U.S. Senate in 2010 because growing entitlements and out-of-control federal spending had exploded our national debt to $14 trillion. We were on an unsustainable path that was mortgaging our children's future.

Fortunately, Americans decided that a government controlled by liberal Democrats wasn't good for the country, and they elected Republicans to the House to halt President Obama's extreme policies. A Republican majority in the Senate followed in 2014.

As I ran for re-election in 2016, we had the prospect of electing a Republican president who could work with a Republican Congress not only to stop the expansion of liberal policies but, we hoped, to reverse some of the damage done during Mr. Obama's administration. I figured we had an opportunity to put America back on the right path, and I was more than willing to dedicate myself to that worthy effort.

By and large, Republican policies worked. Regulatory relief and a more competitive tax system helped create a healthy economy with low inflation and record low unemployment. Strengthening the military deterred our enemies, and policies designed to secure the borders dramatically reduced the flow of illegal immigration.

During the 2016 campaign, I said it would be my last campaign and final term. That was my strong preference, and my wife's--we both looked forward to a normal private life. However, neither of us anticipated the Democrats' complete takeover of government and the disastrous policies they have already inflicted on America and the world, to say nothing of those they threaten to enact in the future.

Nor did we anticipate the pandemic, the government's failed response to it, the loss of freedom that has resulted, and the tyrannical approach taken by the elites who have created and maintained a state of fear that allows them to exercise control over Americans' lives. Instead of everyone working to achieve the goal President Biden stated during his inaugural address--unifying and healing America--it feels as if our nation is being torn apart.

As I travel around Wisconsin and talk to citizens who love our country, I know I am not the only one with grave concerns. My message has always been that America is precious, and it is our solemn duty to make sure it survives and thrives for future generations.

President Reagan warned that freedom is fragile, always one generation away from extinction. As I have told crowds since my first Tea Party speeches in 2010: This is a fight for freedom. This is not someone else's fight, this is our fight, and it's a fight we absolutely must win.

I believe America is in peril. Much as I'd like to ease into a quiet retirement, I don't feel I should. Countless people have encouraged me to run, saying they rely on me to be their voice, to speak plain and obvious truths other elected leaders shirk from expressing--truths the elite in government, mainstream media, and Big Tech don't want you to hear.

In 2010 I promised I would always tell people the truth and that I would never vote with re-election in mind. When re-election isn't your primary motivation, those are easy promises to keep. Today, I am announcing I will continue to fight for freedom in the public realm by running for re-election. It is a decision I haven't made lightly. Having already experienced a growing level of vitriol and false attacks, I certainly don't expect better treatment in the future. For my campaign to succeed, I will need the support of every American who values the truth and refuses to allow lies and distortions to prevail.

Tens of millions of dollars will be spent trying to destroy and defeat me. The mainstream media and Big Tech will contribute their powerful and corrupt voices as the unofficial but reliable communication apparatus of the Democrats. We face powerful forces that desire even more power and control over our lives. Their path, paved with false hope and greater dependency, always leads to tyranny. We cannot let them win.

So I will humbly ask for your endorsement to help me SAVE AMERICA.
---

My message has always been that America is precious, and it is our solemn duty to make sure it survives and thrives for future generations. President Reagan warned that freedom is fragile, always one generation away from extinction. As I have told crowds since my first Tea Party speeches in 2010: This is a fight for freedom. This is not someone else's fight, this is our fight, and it's a fight we absolutely must win. I believe America is in peril. Much as I'd like to ease into a quiet retirement, I don't feel I should. Countless people have encouraged me to run, saying they rely on me to be their voice, to speak plain and obvious truths other elected leaders shirk from expressing--truths the elite in government, mainstream media, and Big Tech don't want you to hear. In 2010 I promised I would always tell people the truth and that I would never vote with re-election in mind. When re-election isn't your primary motivation, those are easy promises to keep. Today, I am announcing I will continue to fight for freedom in the public realm by running for re-election. It is a decision I haven't made lightly. Having already experienced a growing level of vitriol and false attacks, I certainly don't expect better treatment in the future. For my campaign to succeed, I will need the support of every American who values the truth and refuses to allow lies and distortions to prevail. Tens of millions of dollars will be spent trying to destroy and defeat me. The mainstream media and Big Tech will contribute their powerful and corrupt voices as the unofficial but reliable communication apparatus of the Democrats. We face powerful forces that desire even more power and control over our lives. Their path, paved with false hope and greater dependency, always leads to tyranny. We cannot let them win.
